### [87] [Collective Autonomous Vehicle Routing Needs Social Awareness for Coexistence with Human Drivers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13439)
*Anastasia Psarou,Mikolaj Rams,Blazej Torbus,Rafal Kucharski*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文针对自动驾驶车辆（AV）与人驾车辆（HDV）共存的混合交通场景，提出在多智能体强化学习（MARL）的AV路由奖励中引入"边际成本"（marginal cost）作为社会性分量，以缓解自私AV路由对HDV造成的负面外部性。实验在Ingolstadt和Provins两个真实城市路网上验证了引入边际成本可在不牺牲AV自身行驶时间的情况下减少HDV的行程时间恶化，并提出选择性边际成本方法以降低计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当AV通过MARL学习路由策略以最小化自身行驶时间时，可能选择对自身有利但增加HDV行驶时间的路线，形成对其他道路使用者的负面外部性。论文关注如何设计AV路由目标函数，在减少AV行驶时间的同时，限制其对HDV和系统整体造成的额外成本。

Method: 1) 将AV奖励从仅最小化自身行驶时间扩展为 r_i = -e_i(u) - β·m_i(u)，其中边际成本 m_i(u) 通过反事实仿真（将该AV从系统中移除后重新模拟）计算所有其他车辆行驶时间变化的总和；2) 使用REINFORCE算法在SUMO+Ingolstadt（1035行）和Provins（523行）网络上进行MARL训练；3) 提出选择性边际成本（selective marginal cost）方法，通过历史影响评分 H_i（不同路线选择下系统总行驶时间的标准差）识别对系统影响最大的AV子集，仅对这些AV计算边际成本以减少反事实仿真次数。

Result: 在Ingolstadt 40% AV渗透率下：自私路由使HDV行驶时间增加1.7%，引入边际成本（β=0.1）后降至1.1%，同时AV行驶时间也略有改善。增加β可进一步改善HDV但会牺牲AV和系统性能（如β=0.5时系统性能恶化）。选择性方法：仅对40%最具影响力的AV施加边际成本，反事实仿真减少约40%，HDV改善效果仅比全量边际成本低约0.2个百分点，且显著优于随机选择10% AV的基线。

Conclusion: 仅优化个体行驶时间的MARL路由策略会对人类驾驶员产生系统性不利影响。在AV奖励中引入边际成本这种社会性分量，可在不显著牺牲AV自身利益的情况下减轻这种负面影响。然而，过度加权社会分量会损害AV和系统整体性能。选择性边际成本以较低计算成本近似全量边际成本的效果，为可扩展的社会感知AV路由提供了可行路径。研究表明，AV路由算法应超越自私奖励，在目标函数中纳入对共享交通系统影响的考量。

Abstract: Collective Autonomous Vehicle (AV) route choices in real-world traffic networks can create externalities for Human-Driven Vehicles (HDVs), as routes that benefit AVs may increase travel times for other road users. To address this, we introduce a social component, the marginal cost, to the selfish travel time AV reward. Marginal cost captures an AV's impact on other road users by comparing their travel times with those in a counterfactual simulation in which the AV is removed. We study AV route choice in mixed-autonomy traffic settings using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), where AVs learn routing policies through repeated interactions with the traffic environment. Experiments on the real-world networks of Ingolstadt and Provins show that incorporating marginal cost into the AV reward not only limits the increase in HDV travel times and shortens AV travel times relative to selfish AV routing, but also improves overall system performance. In Ingolstadt, selfish routing of 40\% AVs increases the travel times of other vehicles by 1.7\%, and this drops to 1.1\% when the social reward is included. Interestingly, not only does overall system performance improve, but the AVs are also better off when acting this http URL effect is consistent across tested cities, penetration rates, and replications, yet when the weight of the social component in the reward increases, the system fails to reach the desired performance. For a more scalable approach to social AV routing in mixed-autonomy traffic, we compute the marginal cost only for the AVs whose route choices most affect the traffic system. This reduces the number of counterfactual simulations and achieves similar performance at a significantly lower computational cost. Our results suggest that AV routing should go beyond selfish rewards and, for the benefit of all traffic participants, include a social component in its objective.

</details>


### [88] [SoftwareGym: Scaling Computer-Use Agent Training with Diverse Synthesized Software Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12611)
*Tian Jin,Wenhao Wang,Jing Kang,Haoting Shi,Rui Ye,Yijun Lu,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: SoftwareGym 是一个自动化流水线，通过设计、实现、评估三阶段合成多样且功能可靠的桌面 GUI 软件环境，用于大规模训练计算机使用代理（CUA）。利用该流水线生成 182 个跨 12 类别的应用，训练 Qwen3.5-9B 后在 OSWorld（严格域外）上 Pass@3 从 41.39% 提升至 56.97%，并在自建 SoftwareGym-Bench 上达到 40.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 CUA 训练数据合成存在两大瓶颈：原生应用集成成本高、覆盖窄且易过拟合；浏览器托管环境交互深度有限、流程复杂度不足。亟需一种能同时满足交互多样性、功能可靠性和可扩展性的环境合成方法。

Method: 三阶段自动化多智能体流水线：(1) 设计阶段——FunctionDesigner 生成功能规范，StyleDesigner 强制布局差异（至少两维不同），IconDesigner 生成结构化多样 SVG 资产；(2) 实现与评估阶段——Coder/DevCoder 实现应用并做源码级验证，EvalTaskGenerateAgent + GUIAgent 通过鼠标键盘交互做 GUI 检查点测试与迭代修复，同时通过视觉保真度评分确保设计一致性；(3) 任务合成阶段——基于 GUI 验证的能力构建难度分级（easy/normal/hard）的可执行任务。训练采用 Qwen3.5-9B 的多模态 SFT。

Result: 合成 182 个应用跨 12 类别，平均 GUI 通过率 91.5%（v1: 54.9% → v2: 81.1% → v3: 91.5%），每个应用平均耗时 237.3 分钟、$70.76。功能覆盖：8 个对齐类别中 49 个主要模块全覆盖、78.8% 具体功能被验证。在严格域外 OSWorld 上 Pass@3 从 41.39% 提升到 56.97%（+15.58），在 SoftwareGym-Bench（120 任务）上达到 40.0%，超过 Qwen3.7-Plus 及多个更大规模专用 CUA。消融实验：(1) 结构化设计将蓝图多样性从 4.9 提升到 83.6；(2) GUI 引导修复使通过率从 50.4% 升至 83.1%，而仅源码修复仅微升至 48.8%；(3) 联合 OSWorld+SoftwareGym 训练在 SoftwareGym-Bench 上进一步达到 47.5%。

Conclusion: 合成软件环境可以作为原生软件的可扩展补充，提供多样、可靠且运行时验证的 CUA 训练监督。SoftwareGym 证明通过自动化设计多样性控制、GUI 引导的迭代修复和能力验证的任务合成，能够训练出在严格未见过的真实桌面应用上具有强迁移能力的紧凑模型。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet synthesizing diverse and reliable software environments at scale remains challenging. Native application environments require substantial construction and integration effort, which limits application coverage and increases the risk of application-specific overfitting. Browser-hosted environments provide limited interaction depth and workflow complexity. These limitations motivate SoftwareGym, an automated pipeline for synthesizing GUI software environments with diverse interfaces, executable functionality, and runtime-verified behavior. It generates structurally diverse designs, realizes them as runnable applications, and uses GUI evaluation with iterative repair to ensure functional reliability. Using SoftwareGym, we synthesize 182 applications across twelve categories and achieve a mean GUI task pass rate of 91.5%. We construct SoftwareGym-Bench, a 120-task evaluation suite spanning the same twelve categories, and use trajectories collected from these environments for CUA training. The resulting model improves Pass@3 from 41.39% to 56.97% on the strictly out-of-domain OSWorld benchmark and achieves 40.0% on SoftwareGym-Bench. These results demonstrate the potential of synthesized software environments as scalable and transferable supervision for CUA training.

</details>


### [89] [How Do Hardware Faults Manifest Differently in LLM Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12756)
*Aiden Rubey,Zachary Coalson,Cong Chen,Jean-Philippe Monteuuis,Jonathan Petit,Sanghyun Hong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: We present the first systematic study of the resilience of large language model (LLM) agents to random hardware-induced faults. Prior work on hardware fault resilience in LLMs focuses on model-level outcomes, such as incorrect outputs or generation failures. Yet LLM agents repeatedly interact with tools and environments, creating loops that can change how hardware faults manifest. We conduct an extensive evaluation across three agent benchmarks, comprising 6,814 agent executions: 2,400+ clean runs and 4,300+ fault-injected runs with independently sampled random two-bit weight faults. We trace how these faults propagate through agent execution. Unlike prior studies, we find that agentic execution transforms model-level corruption into distinct system-level outcomes: (1) agents can recover from faulty model outputs and still complete tasks correctly; (2) this recovery increases computational and execution costs; (3) a few faults cause subtle but semantically meaningful errors while the agent otherwise behaves normally; and (4) for some models and scenarios, faults can alter security and alignment behavior.

### [90] [SwingGuard: Risk-Conditioned Multi-Agent Swing Trading with Dual-Timescale Governance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12988)
*Junzhou Su,Yichen Luo,Yebo Feng,Teng Li,Jiahua Xu*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Cryptocurrency swing trading spans mismatched timescales: positions remain active while market and event risk can change within minutes. However, many predictive and large language model (LLM)-based trading systems assess risk after strategy generation or run both functions at the same cadence, leaving proposals unconditioned by current risk and exposure weakly governed between revisions. We propose SwingGuard, a dual-timescale, long-only multi-agent framework for risk-conditioned strategy generation. At the strategy timescale, specialized analysts synthesize point-in-time technical, sentiment, on-chain, and macroeconomic evidence through bullish-bearish deliberation. The resulting evidence and current risk context are then combined by a Portfolio Architect to form a target position. At the governance timescale, a five-minute Risk Controller performs conditional diagnosis, maintains persistent risk states with staged recovery, audits the proposal, and constrains execution until the next strategy revision. This design allows risk to shape the feasible strategy before proposal finalization while continuing to govern the active position afterward. Evaluations on Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ETH) show that SwingGuard preserves positive returns after transaction costs while maintaining shallow drawdowns and strong risk-adjusted performance on both assets. The exposure-capped joint portfolio achieves a Sharpe ratio of 2.98, compared with 2.79 for an otherwise identical Post-hoc Risk variant. Structured traces further link risk evidence and state transitions to strategy constraints and executed position changes, providing an auditable framework for asynchronous cryptocurrency swing trading. Overall, the results indicate that conditioning strategy formation on current risk, together with persistent high-frequency governance, improves risk-adjusted performance without sacrificing auditability.

### [91] [The Limits of Manipulation within Personalized Incentive Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13133)
*Andrea Araldo,Alessa Mayer,Ravi Seshadri,Amir Brudner*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Demand management policies aim to shift individual behavior toward sustainable choices (e.g., goods, transport modes). Personalized incentive policies tailor subsidies to agents' needs and constraints, but personalization also exposes the regulator to agents' strategic manipulative behavior. The extent to which agents can profitably manipulate such policies remains poorly understood, which limits their applicability. This paper establishes analytically the conditions under which manipulation benefits the agent. We formalize a Stackelberg game in which an agent may simulate a different profile to extract higher incentives from a regulator. Previous work typically assumes that the regulator would instantaneously classify agents into the simulated user profile. In contrast, we explicitly model the regulator's process of learning the agent profile, based on observed past behavior. This makes manipulation harder, since it forces the agent to consistently behave according to a simulated profile, thus renouncing following their true preferences. Manipulative agents thus incur a Cost of Manipulation, which has typically been neglected. By accounting for it, we get a counterintuitive finding: although classification uncertainty reduces personalization accuracy, it may benefit the regulator by deterring manipulation. We establish an upper bound on the agent's gain from manipulation, which becomes stricter as profiles become harder to distinguish for the regulator. Simulations on the London Passenger Mode Choice dataset illustrate this deterrence effect. The framework can therefore be used to stress-test the robustness of personalized incentive policies before deployment.

### [92] [When AI Advisors Agree: Distinguishing Forecast Risk from Forecast Reliability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13431)
*Russlan Ramdowar*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: If seven AI advisors give similar forecasts, should we trust them more? Agreement can indicate useful shared evidence, but it can also reflect an asset that was easier to forecast in the first place. We examine this distinction using 928 completed first-quarter forecasts for 232 assets across four production batches of iPulse AI. Ten historical Gemini configurations are grouped into seven investment frameworks; their archived forecasts are compared with later market outcomes, without generating new reports. Mean absolute return error rises from 10.31 percentage points in the lowest-disagreement quartile to 21.05 in the highest. Yet a forecast of no price change shows almost the same increase, from 9.89 to 21.15. The relationship between disagreement and additional forecast error is not resolved after accounting for visible asset risk. Retaining the quarter of forecasts with lowest historical volatility produces lower error than retaining those with least disagreement: 7.97 versus 10.31 percentage points. Agreement about direction behaves differently. When at least six of seven frameworks share a direction, directional accuracy is higher, but return-magnitude error is also larger. These results distinguish three questions often collapsed into one confidence score: how risky the asset is, whether advisors agree on its direction, and how precisely they forecast its return. For this historical council, agreement is informative in specific ways; it is not a general certificate of forecast reliability.

### [93] [OpenSocialJax: Evaluating Social Adaptation in Sequential Social Dilemmas with Open-Ended Environmental Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13710)
*Zihao Guo,Meng Fang,Joel Z. Leibo,Yali Du*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: Sequential social dilemma benchmarks capture diverse social interactions, but rarely test whether agents can infer hidden environmental rules through repeated interaction while adapting to other agents. We introduce \textbf{OpenSocialJax}, which extends Clean Up and Commons Harvest across an open-ended distribution of latent environment configurations, systematically varying spatial layouts and hidden rules governing tool crafting, payoffs, and resource dynamics. Each episode samples one configuration from tens of millions of possibilities and holds it fixed across five trials. We evaluate eight large language models, including three closed source models and five open source models. Our evaluation tests whether models can discover hidden rules and adapt to other agents in homogeneous and mixed teams. We find that rule discovery often improves performance but does not reliably sustain cooperation, as the cleaning burden becomes concentrated among fewer agents in OpenCleanup and every team eventually exhausts the shared resource in OpenHarvest. In our mixed arena, one cooperative agent was able to sustain the public good in OpenCleanup at a cost to its own return, but could not prevent resource depletion in OpenHarvest. Together, these results highlight the difficulty of adapting jointly to unfamiliar environmental dynamics and the changing behavior of other agents.

### [94] [Ask Your Advisor: Learning When to Consult Stronger Models in Agentic Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13870)
*Pascal Sowietzki,Steffen Holter,Yannick Metz,Emil Kasper,Raphael Baur,Mennatallah El-Assady*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: To balance task performance and computational cost, agentic workflows can use a lower-cost model for execution and selectively consult a stronger model. In such executor-advisor systems, the executor decides when to seek advice, making escalation depend on self-assessment, although current language models struggle to detect where their own reasoning fails. The need for stronger reasoning emerges during execution and varies across workflow phases. We introduce ARIA, a meta-controller that learns when to consult by balancing task success against consultation cost. Our approach formulates consultation as a sequential resource-allocation problem. At workflow contact points, ARIA maps execution evidence to a compact state abstraction and selects SILENT or CONSULT, with action values learned by Monte Carlo control from cost-penalized outcomes. Across evaluated tasks of SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench 2.1, and $\tau^2$-bench, ARIA recovers 44-81% of the executor-advisor success gap at less than half the advisor model's cost. ARIA achieves the best observed success-cost trade-off among ten other evaluated conditions, including routing and cascading methods, fixed and prompted consultation, and random placement at matched advice volume. The policies are compact and inspectable, with a single consultation-price parameter governing the success-cost trade-off without retraining either underlying model.

### [95] [Minions: A Dynamic and Distributed Virtual GPU Cloud Built on Idle Apple Silicon Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12970)
*Jianhua Li,Yun Xing,Girisha De Silva,Ryan Flint,Kai Yuan,Sean Suchter*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Minions，一个基于Apple Silicon空闲GPU的分布式推理云平台，通过聚合macOS设备空闲算力解决集中式GPU资源紧缺问题，支持embedding和LLM推理，具备任务容错和动态绑定机制，并将十小时以上队列时间压缩至分钟级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式GPU集群面临成本高、弹性不足、排队时间长的问题，而Apple Silicon设备上的GPU在日常使用中大量闲置，由此产生能否将闲置GPU聚合为共享分布式推理平台的的动机。

Method: 系统采用四组件架构（Minion Server、PostgreSQL元数据存储、Minion Executor、Minion Watchdog），Executor以pull方式通过REST从Server获取子任务，利用PostgreSQL唯一约束原子获取执行权（心跳监测与动态任务绑定优先级），使用S3解耦存储，集成HuggingFace和Ollama分别运行embedding和LLM推理，通过Grafana从数据库 派生观测指标。

Result: 部署实践表明Minions可将推理任务排队时间从超过10小时压缩至分钟级，无需额外GPU采购或基础设施成本，具备有机扩展能力，并支持团队/组织范围部署以保障数据保密性。

Conclusion: Minions验证了闲置macOS设备可作为实用分布式GPU推理平台的，未来扩展到分布式模型训练，并探索跨组织乃至跨社区的闲置GPU安全联邦化为大规模共享GPU资源池的可能性。

Abstract: The increasing demand for GPU-accelerated machine learning inference has exposed limitations in centralized GPU infrastructures, including high cost, limited elasticity, and long wait times under resource constraints. At the same time, modern Apple Silicon-based macOS devices are equipped with powerful GPUs that remain largely idle during normal usage. This paper presents Minions, a dynamic and distributed virtual GPU cloud that aggregates idle Apple Silicon GPUs across macOS devices to execute large-scale machine learning inference workloads. Minions enables teams to leverage existing hardware without requiring additional GPU procurement. The system provides flexible GPU inference task execution, fault tolerance, and efficient resource utilization. Our experience shows that idle macOS devices can be transformed into a practical distributed GPU inference platform in environments where centralized GPU resources are constrained.

</details>


### [96] [SlackSwap: Bandwidth-Aware Activation Swapping and Recomputation for Memory-Efficient DNN Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13003)
*Hui Feng,Xun Zhou,Yuxin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出SlackSwap，一种面向DNN训练中节省GPU显存的两遍式规划器与运行时策略。它将主机链路时间视为显式资源预算（link budget），结合swap和重计算，在A100上模拟BERT-Large、GPT-2 XL和Llama-7B模型，仅用一半激活内存即可保留96-100%无限制显存吞吐量，性能为最佳基线的1.10-1.11倍，方案接近0.5%遗传搜索结果，规划时间小于0.4秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着GPU算力（Titan X到H100提升141倍）远超CPU-GPU链路带宽（仅提升3.9倍）的增长，传统交换（swapping）方法（如vDNN、SuperNeurons、SwapAdvisor）无视链路承载能力造成传输阻塞，而块检查点（block checkpointing）则闲置链路资源。现有A100仅能隐藏11-38%的Transformer激活数据交换，急需一种协调swap与recomputation的链路感知调度机制。

Method: SlackSwap的核心方法包括：(1) 链路预算（link budget）模型f=min(1, I/β)，其中I为前向FLOPs/保存字节，β为机器的FLOPs per byte/s链路带宽；(2) 两遍规划算法——Pass 1按ρ_t=c_t/s_t降序将最优链路预算分配给最难重计算的tensor，使用FIFO D2H和最早截止期限优先（EDF）H2D调度且无每层同步屏障；Pass 2沿内存剖面覆盖剩余超额部分，选择成本最低的recompute；(3) 基于双DMA队列和最近最久未使用（LRU）回退策略的barrier-free运行时机制；(4) 验证修复通过事件模型重放并迭代优化方案。

Result: 在A100、PCIe 4.0的仿真中，SlackSwap在50%激活内存下对BERT-Large、GPT-2 XL和Llama-7B分别保留96.3%、97.6%和99.6%的理想吞吐，为最佳基线的1.10-1.11倍；30%内存下保留89.7-97.0%为基线1.07-1.16倍；10%内存下（块检查点无法容纳）仍维持79.7-87.3%，且无线性瓶颈停滞。其方案与45秒遗传搜索（6600-14000方案）差距小于0.5%，规划时间仅67-376ms。消融实验表明Barriers-free运行时贡献最大性能。

Conclusion: SlackSwap通过显式建模链路预算，有效解决了GPU算力与主机链路带宽失衡问题，使swap与recompute协同优于单独任一方案。论文揭示了当链路带宽达数百GB/s（一致链路）或长序列场景下，方法自然从recompute偏向swap，为统一内存预取等未来工作提供了原则性框架。其局限在于仅基于仿真，未直接整合ZeRO-Offload梯度流量和共享PCIe场景，并需要GPU分析工具或框架钩子提供单次性能剖析迭代数据。

Abstract: Swapping saved activations to host memory once enabled GPUs to train models that exceeded their device-memory capacity when compute throughput and host-link bandwidth were roughly balanced. For example, on a 2015 Titan X, PCIe bandwidth was sufficient to offload all VGG-16 activations during the forward pass. This balance no longer holds. From the Titan X to the H100, peak training throughput increased by 141x, whereas host-link bandwidth improved by only 3.9x. On an A100, the host link can hide transfers for only 11-38% of the activations in the transformer models we study. Existing swapping approaches, such as vDNN, SuperNeurons, and SwapAdvisor, offload tensors according to memory requirements without explicitly respecting the available link-time budget, resulting in transfer-induced stalls; block checkpointing, in contrast, leaves the host link underutilized. We present SlackSwap, which treats host-link time as an explicit resource budget. Using a single profiled iteration, SlackSwap allocates the forward-pass link budget to tensors that are most expensive to recompute, resolves the remaining memory deficit by recomputing the least expensive tensors, and schedules FIFO offloads and earliest-deadline-first prefetches without per-layer synchronization barriers. In trace-driven simulations of BERT-Large, GPT-2 XL, and a Llama-7B-style model on an A100, SlackSwap retains 96-100% of unlimited-memory GPU throughput while using half the activation memory, achieving 1.10-1.11x the throughput of the best baseline. Its plans are within 0.5% of a genetic search over 6,600-14,000 candidate plans, while requiring less than 0.4 seconds to generate.

</details>


### [97] [Execution-Feasible Dispatch of LLM Pre-training Loads for Renewable-Dominant AI Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13047)
*Xi Tong,Ershun Du,Haiyang Jiang,Long Chen,Qin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对以新能源为主的AI数据中心（特别是LLM预训练负载），提出了一种"执行可行"的调度框架。其核心是将LLM任务描述符映射到checkpoint（检查点）域的工作负载，再进一步映射到满足吞吐量、GPU容量、内存、IT功耗等约束的3D并行（数据/张量/流水线并行）GPU执行模式，并构建checkpoint状态图嵌入日前电力调度MILP模型，实现与电网购电、弃风弃光、储能（BESS）的协调。最后通过2048 GPU的AIDC及两个LLaMA预训练任务（LLaMA-13B和LLaMA-33B）案例验证，相比固定连续训练，运行成本降低20.02%，弃风弃光从1.077 MWh降至0.014 MWh。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究通常将AI数据中心（AIDC）的电力需求视为连续可调或通用可延迟，从而**高估了LLM预训练的灵活性**。LLM预训练是顺序优化过程，时间偏移受checkpoint状态约束，恢复时的功率水平由离散的GPU并行配置决定（而非连续的功率指令）。因此，核心挑战在于如何推导出一种"执行可行"的AIDC负荷模型，使其真实参与电力调度，避免简单平移负荷。

Method: 1. **任务-计算映射**：根据Transformer FLOPs公式（5），由LLM描述符（模型规模、token目标、批次、序列长度等）计算每次迭代工作量、每日tranche迭代次数、日工作量C_j，并将进度划分到K_j^seg个聚合checkpoint段。2. **计算-资源映射**：枚举3D并行配置 a=(p,q,d)，满足整除性（公式16）、GPU内存约束（公式14-15，状态+激活+开销）以及GPU容量上限，筛选可行模式A_j；按Pareto支配（少GPU、低功耗、高吞吐）剪枝得到有效模式A_j^eff。3. **Checkpoint状态图**：构建图G_j=(V_j,E_j)，节点为(时间τ, checkpoint k)，边分两类——等待边（零功耗）、训练边（执行ℓ_{j,a,Δk}个时段，消耗Δk个checkpoint段计算量）。用网络流约束（公式26）保证从源到汇（g_j）的单条可行路径，从而强制checkpoint状态连续性与最终完成。4. **日前调度MILP**：目标函数最小化电网购电、弃风弃光、储能吞吐成本之和；约束包括路径连续（26）、模式解码（27-29）、GPU与AIDC容量（30）、绿色电力母线功率平衡（32）、BESS动态（34，含充放电互斥、SOC上下限、末态复位）。模型为MILP，离散执行可行性通过剪枝后的A_j^eff和图G_j内在保证。

Result: 基于CAISO风光与TOU电价数据，2048 GPU的AIDC（A100，80GB显存，PUE=1.25），两个LLaMA任务（LLaMA-13B：4.9%日分配额，12段/24h；LLaMA-33B：2.02%日分配额）。六种场景对比：S1（固定基准）成本473.03 USD、弃风弃光1.077 MWh、绿电占比63.20%；S4（执行可行checkpoint+3D调度，无储能）成本378.33 USD、降20.02%，弃风弃光降至0.014 MWh，绿电占比66.12%；S6（+BESS）成本377.79 USD、降20.13%，弃风弃光为0，储能吞吐仅0.026 MWh；理想化S3（仅3D无checkpoint连续约束）成本368.99 USD、降21.99%（乐观基准）。S2与S1完全一致，证明checkpoint记录本身不创造灵活性。敏感性分析：12段checkpoint已捕获绝大部分灵活性；GPU容量<1280不可行；风光配比达1.5时成本和弃风弃光反而回升，标志灵活性吸收能力饱和。LLaMA-13B生成135个可行配置、剪枝后12个有效模式、最优解仅激活4个；LLaMA-33B相应为111/21/3个。LLM-B可在某checkpoint等待3小时，再以可行3D模式恢复，所有24h进度100%完成。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一种将LLM预训练固有结构（checkpoint与3D并行模式）显式映射为电力系统可行负荷状态的调度框架，揭示"灵活的电网交互能力源于checkpoint等待与执行可行3D模式补偿的结合，而非checkpoint记录本身"。在新能源主导的AIDC中，工作负载整形提供了主导灵活性，BESS仅承担残余平衡。数值结果显示显著的成本和弃风弃光削减效果。未来工作将扩展至多日随机调度、其他AI工作负载（微调/推理）、共享GPU池的空闲机会成本，以及多AIDC协同调度。

Abstract: AI data centers (AIDCs) are emerging as large power-system loads, making their operational flexibility increasingly valuable. Existing studies often treat AIDC demand as continuously adjustable or generically delay-tolerant, which overstating the flexibility of large language model (LLM) pretraining. This paper proposes an execution-feasible dispatch framework for LLM pre-training in renewable-dominant AIDCs. LLM descriptors are first converted into checkpoint-domain daily workloads, then mapped to feasible 3D-parallel GPU modes with explicit throughput, GPU-capacity, memory, and IT-power limits. The resulting checkpoint- and mode-constrained load states are embedded into a day-ahead power dispatch model. Case studies on a 2048 GPUs AIDC with two LLaMA pretraining tasks show that checkpoint-aware 3D dispatch reduces operating cost by 20.02% and renewable curtailment from 1.077 to 0.014 MWh relative to fixed continuous training. Related results also show that checkpoint records alone do not create load flexibility,practical grid-interactive flexibility arises from checkpoint waiting combined with execution-feasible 3D-mode compensation.

</details>


### [98] [Capturing Electrical Windows Through Reconfigurable Optical Networks: Transfer-aware Scheduling of Multi-Region AI Data Centers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13061)
*Xi Tong,Zijian Li,Xiaoyi Fan,Cong Zhang,Ershun Du,Qin Wang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多区域AI数据中心的"传输感知"（transfer-aware）算力-电力-网络联合调度框架，通过光路交换（OCS）将checkpoint传输与可再生能源窗口捕获相协调，在五AIDC基准测试中相对静态光网络降低12.50%的实时购电成本并提升2.724个百分点的本地可再生能源利用率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数据中心跨区域迁移训练负载以利用可再生能源或低电价窗口时，若忽视checkpoint传输时延（即"transfer-blind"），可能高估迁移收益，或导致后续训练无法在窗口期内恢复运行。

Method: 构建紧凑的算力-电力主问题生成候选调度方案，再通过精确多商品流（multicommodity flow）认证来验证checkpoint在共享链路容量约束下的可达性；若不可行则利用更新后的时延估计修正候选方案。集成日前（day-ahead）规划、事件触发日内（intraday）更新与分钟级实时（real-time）调度三级协调方法。采用动态OCS替代固定光路配对，使光路带宽成为可调度资源。

Result: 在五AIDC基准中，Dynamic OCS方案（D）相对静态光网络（C）降低实时购电成本12.50%（49.49% C-to-B成本差距），提升本地RE利用率2.724个百分点。checkpoint迁移平均时长从69.31分钟降至17.10分钟（-75.33%），后继任务就绪延迟从32分钟降至0。最大爬坡降低28.55%，日前-实时偏差降低29.19%。消融分析表明，网络压力是OCS价值的关键放大器，价格/可再生能源再分布单独不产生收益，三者共同作用才产生显著价值。

Conclusion: 可重构光网络能有效缩短checkpoint传输时间、提升本地可再生能源消纳能力，并减少极端电网调节冲击。但收益取决于电网密集度（network pressure）与空间性电价/可再生能源窗口的联合对齐。未来工作将使用运营实测数据，并扩展至潮流约束、备用市场及更大规模的可重构电路组合。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence data centers (AIDCs) can provide spatiotemporal load flexibility by migrating training workloads in response to regional electricity prices and renewable-energy (RE) availability. However, transfer-blind scheduling may overestimate migration benefits by overlooking transfer time or prevent training from resuming within renewable-rich or low-price windows when considering transfer time. This paper proposes a transfer-aware compute-electricity-network scheduling framework that coordinates training placement, checkpoint transmission, and optical circuit switching (OCS) to improve local RE utilization and reduce grid-purchase cost. A compact compute-electricity master problem generates candidate schedules using estimated transfer delays. The framework then schedules optical circuits, verifies checkpoint delivery under shared-link capacity constraints, and revises infeasible schedules using updated delay estimates. It integrates day-ahead planning, event-triggered intraday updates, and real-time dispatch. In a five-AIDC benchmark with equal completed work and network resources, the proposed method reduces the real-time grid purchase cost by 12.50% and increases the local RE utilization by 2.724 percentage points relative to static optical operation. Sensitivity and ablation analyses indicate that OCS is particularly beneficial when renewable-rich or low-price windows shift across sites and network bottlenecks hinder timely checkpoint delivery.

</details>


### [99] [Multi-Source and Multi-Dimensional Information Fusion in Resource-Constrained Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13298)
*Yushi Wang,Zhengxin Yu,Guhan Zheng,Wang Miao,Merouane Debbah*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文针对资源受限边缘网络中多源多维语义信息融合问题，提出了一个统一框架，核心包含Hyper-Slot融合模块和基于Stackelberg-Nash博弈的激励机制，通过迭代token-to-slot分配融合异构语义token并协调终端上传策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G边缘网络中分布式终端持续产生多模态语义信息，但受限于通信与计算资源，边缘服务器仅能接收不完整且在模态、语义粒度、到达时间、信道条件等方面存在异构性的token；现有融合方法难以协同优化选择性上传与多维异构token融合，且独立决策易导致冗余上传或互补信息缺失。

Method: 1) 多源语义通信与开销建模：定义候选token集合、归一化传输质量b_{m,i}∈[0,1]、计算与通信能耗模型；2) Hyper-Slot融合模块：将token属性η_i编码为描述符d_i，与语义嵌入联合计算token-slot亲和度，经sparsemax稀疏分配、GRU迭代更新实现token-to-slot分配与slot-to-token反馈，固定K个slot聚合为紧凑表征；3) 基于贡献的激励机制：以Hyper-Slot分配权重定义融合增益F(b)（覆盖+互补性），终端边际贡献Δ_m(b)=F(b)-F(0_m,b_{-m})，构建双层Stackelberg-Nash博弈——终端侧阻尼最佳响应迭代求解Nash均衡，边缘服务器侧数值梯度上升确定奖励池R；4) 端到端训练含任务损失与多样性正则L_div。

Result: 在COCO2014三模态扩展数据集上mAP达0.7610±0.0239，较最强基线（SCAN/Slot Attention的0.724）提升3.66个百分点；Flickr30K跨模态检索RSum达478.9±3.4，较Slot Attention提升15.9点；参数较Concat+MLP基线减少超80%；25%传输预算下mAP仍领先Top-importance策略5.46个百分点；消融实验证实紧凑瓶颈与迭代依赖建模互补；博弈仿真显示奖励池R*=4.91时服务器效用最大，激励按贡献差异化分配。

Conclusion: 所提框架能够联合协调边缘网络中选择性语义上传与多维异构token融合，Hyper-Slot通过语义内容与属性联合建模实现紧凑鲁棒表征，Stackelberg-Nash博弈实现贡献驱动的资源分配，为6G资源受限边缘智能提供有效解决方案。

Abstract: Multi-source semantic information fusion enables edge networks to support global inference using observations collected by distributed terminals. However, limited communication and computation resources restrict semantic uploading, leaving the edge server with incomplete tokens that differ in modality, semantic granularity, arrival time, and channel condition. The value of these tokens also depends on the complementary or redundant information provided by other terminals. In this paper, we propose a multi-source and multi-dimensional semantic information fusion framework that coordinates terminal uploading and edge-side fusion under resource constraints. We develop Hyper-Slot to combine semantic content with available token attributes through iterative token-to-slot assignment and slot-to-token feedback, producing a compact representation for global inference. To encourage useful semantic uploading, we further design a contribution-based incentive mechanism that uses Hyper-Slot assignments to evaluate information coverage and cross-type complementarity. A bi-level Stackelberg-Nash game determines the server reward pool and terminal transmission-quality strategies while accounting for computation and communication energy costs. Experiments on a tri-modal extension of COCO2014 and image-text retrieval on Flickr30K show that Hyper-Slot improves mAP by 3.66 percentage points and RSum by 15.9 points over the strongest evaluated baselines, respectively, while reducing the number of parameters by more than 80% compared with a naive concatenation-based fusion baseline.

</details>


### [100] [SnapShare: Isolation-Preserving Deduplication for Serverless Snapshots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13318)
*Leonid Kondrashov,Likun Zhang,André Filipe do Pilar de Jesus,Hans Pistor,Marco Cali,Riccardo Mancini,Rodrigo Bruno,Dmitrii Ustiugov*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: SnapShare 是面向无服务器计算（AWS Lambda 等）VM 快照的集群级管理系统，在保证跨租户强隔离的同时通过选择性去重将端到端冷启动尾延迟降低 10–29%，远程存储降低 39%，本地缓存占用降低 38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无服务器平台为缩短冷启动普遍采用 VM 快照恢复，但因内容去重会引发跨租户时序侧信道泄露敏感数据，生产平台（如 AWS Lambda）被迫对不同租户的快照实施严格的零共享隔离，导致公共基础设施组件无法去重，浪费 worker 缓存容量并加剧冷启动延迟。论文刻画发现非敏感的共享基础设施约占快照内容 70%、工作集约 50%，存在巨大的安全可利用的共享机会。

Method: 1) 离线分类器：对每个 4KB 快照页计算 MD5，与提供商批准的参考源（基础快照、根文件系统、容器镜像）做完整内容匹配；只有完全匹配才标记为 Shared，任何不匹配标记为 Private。2) 部署时通过 userfaultfd 剖析将页划分为 Working Set（预取）与 Lazy（按需）。3) 远程存储划分为 Shared/Private × Working-Set/Lazy 四象限，共享惰性页用基于内容的标识，私有页用租户+函数版本标识。4) Worker 本地缓存分区：Shared 分区对低基数公共组件做 pinning（<1% 容量），Private 分区按 LRU 淘汰并严格按租户隔离。5) 冷启动时 Controller 复用驻留的共享组件并预取缺失的私有工作集，页错误处理程序对工作集外访问做 4KB 按需取页。实现基于 vHive/Knative/Firecracker。

Result: 在 10 节点 CloudLab 集群、17 个 vSwarm 基准和 700 条 Azure Functions 轨迹上的评估：相对 Sabre 基线，远程存储降低 39%，本地缓存降低 38%（距 unsafe Full-Dedup 仅 6% 和 3%）；P99 尾延迟较 Chunks 基线降 29%、较 Sabre 降 10%；网络获取负载平均降 56%；在 1–10 Gbps 带宽扫描下均接近 unsafe Full-Dedup，最差情况取页延迟最多降低 10×；zstd 与 Intel IAA 硬件解压延迟相当；禁用容器镜像去重（SnapShare-）仍可获得 31% 的缓存节省。

Conclusion: SnapShare 通过"完整内容匹配批准参考源"这一保守且由运营方控制的共享边界，实现了高密度缓存与存储去重而不损害敏感数据隔离；其存储与缓存占用逼近理论上不安全但完全去重的设计，性能接近 unsafe 上界，同时为运营商提供动态策略入口（如 CVE 响应时撤回共享资格）。该方案填补了无服务器快照去重系统在隔离保证方面的空白。

Abstract: The efficiency of serverless computing fundamentally depends on rapid function startup, a challenge increasingly addressed by restoring from virtual machine snapshots. However, because content deduplication techniques can open timing-channel attacks that leak sensitive tenant data, production platforms like AWS Lambda instead enforce strict, zero-sharing isolation between snapshots of different tenants. While secure, this isolation precludes the deduplication of common infrastructure components, wasting per-worker cache capacity and exacerbating cold-start latency through inefficient remote fetching. Our characterization reveals that non-sensitive, shareable infrastructure accounts for roughly 70% of a typical snapshot's contents and, on average, about 50% of its working set. We present SnapShare, a cluster-wide snapshot management system that co-designs storage and caching to exploit this commonality without compromising sensitive data isolation. SnapShare classifies a snapshot page as shareable only when its full content matches that of a page from a provider-approved source; any non-matching content is treated as isolated private content. Common infrastructure components are selectively deduplicated and pinned across the cluster's worker nodes, while private data remains strictly isolated and is eagerly fetched as part of the tracked working set, falling back to on-demand retrieval only for pages that fall outside it. Implemented as an extension to Knative, SnapShare reduces end-to-end tail request slowdowns by 10-29% compared to traditional working-set and chunk-based platforms. It also reduces remote storage requirements by 39% and local cache footprints by 38%, reducing network retrieval payloads and bounding worst-case fetch delays by 10x.

</details>


### [101] [Taking Tokenization off the Host for Agentic LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13325)
*Mohammad Siavashi,Pascal Schwinte,Ali Banaei,Gerald Q. Maguire Jr.,Marco Chiesa,Dejan Kostić*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: GraphTok 是一个 GPU 端分词器，将 BPE 分词的完整流水线（前分词、BPE 合并、token ID 组装）封装为单个可重放的 CUDA Graph，针对智能体 LLM 服务中分词成为瓶颈的场景，在 vLLM 和 NVIDIA Dynamo 中实现了显著的延迟和容量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体工作负载（如编码代理）反复发送长上下文，但每次只有少量新增。Prefix caching 跳过了大部分 prefill，使得 CPU 分词成为 TTFT 的最大瓶颈。一个为整个 GPU 集群分词的前端限制了它能供给的 GPU 数量。

Method: GraphTok 将整个编码流水线（前分词→BPE 合并→token ID 组装）作为单个可重放的 CUDA Graph 执行。其关键设计包括：(1) 并行前分词器——通过本地字符类和紧凑的运行信息评估每个位置的前分词边界；(2) Warp 协作 BPE——在 warp 内通过 `__reduce_min_sync` 识别下一个最高优先级合并，保持参考合并顺序；(3) 图内可变长度执行——通过分离固定容量和实际占用率，在捕获的图内处理输入相关的工作量；(4) 完整 GPU 路径——支持 host 返回和 device 驻留输出。集成了 vLLM 的分词器工厂和 NVIDIA Dynamo 的 Rust 前端，并保留参考分词器作为回退。

Result: 1. 正确性：在 GPT-2、Llama 3、Qwen 2.5、DeepSeek-V3 和 Gemma 3 上，逐位复现参考分词器的 token ID。
2. 单个分词性能：在 Llama 3 上比最强 CPU 分词器 gigatoken 快 4.7–6.0×，单文档完整调用（包括传输）在 1.7–3.2 ms 内编码 100 万 GPT-2 tokens。
3. vLLM 集成：在 99% prefix 复用下，均值 TTFT 降低 2.1–2.4×。
4. Dynamo 容量：在 2 s P99 目标下，单个前端可承载 518 req/s 的 121k-token 流量（56 个 GPU 的流量），而 gigatoken 为 296，默认分词器为 18.5。
5. 共享主机测试：在与编码代理共享的主机上，比 gigatoken 节省 6.7–8.7× 的主机 CPU。

Conclusion: GraphTok 证明 GPU 分词不需要牺牲准确性。在 CPU 路由交叉点以上，它在独立、批处理和 TokTier 单请求协议上都是测量中最快的引擎。在单个无竞争请求中，快 CPU tokenizers 与 GraphTok 的差距在 3–18% 以内；优势主要体现在容量上——使用 GraphTok 后，Dynamo 自身的请求路径而非分词成为限制。下一阶段是让引擎直接消费设备驻留的 token ID。

Abstract: Agentic workloads resend long contexts that barely change between calls. Prefix caching now skips most of their prefill, yet every request must still be tokenized in full before the cache can even be consulted. Tokenization, a CPU stage long treated as negligible, becomes the largest part of time-to-first-token (TTFT), and a frontend that tokenizes for a whole GPU fleet limits how many GPUs it can feed. We present GraphTok, a GPU tokenizer that runs the entire encoding pipeline, from pre-tokenization through byte-pair encoding (BPE) merging to token-ID assembly, as one replayable CUDA graph. GraphTok reproduces the reference token IDs bit-for-bit on GPT-2, Llama 3, Qwen 2.5, DeepSeek-V3, and Gemma 3, hands short inputs to a CPU engine where the GPU cannot win, and plugs into unmodified vLLM and NVIDIA Dynamo. GraphTok encodes one million GPT-2 tokens in 1.7-3.2 ms including data transfers, and on Llama 3 it is 4.7-6.0x faster than gigatoken, the strongest CPU tokenizer. On TokTier's own single-request benchmark, it is 2.6-3.9x faster than gigatoken and up to 18.1x faster than TokTier. In vLLM with a cached prefix, it lowers mean TTFT by 2.1-2.4x. The largest gain is capacity. Within a 2 s P99 target, one Dynamo frontend with GraphTok sustains 518 requests/s of 121k-token traffic, the busiest-hour load of 56 GPUs, against 296 with gigatoken and 18.5 with the default tokenizer. Across 121k to one million tokens, this is 1.75-2.5x the load gigatoken sustains, with a P99 up to 64x lower where gigatoken's tail breaks.

</details>


### [102] [Stacked Intelligent Metasurface-Based MultiModal Feature Fusion for Collaborative Inference in Edge Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13364)
*Yushi Wang,Zhengxin Yu,Guhan Zheng,Haris Pervaiz,Zheyi Chen,Shunqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出SIM-CI框架，将堆叠智能超表面（SIM）作为物理计算单元，在电磁波传播过程中直接执行多用户多模态协作推理，结合三异构性鲁棒适配器和混合波束成形网络，在6G边缘网络中实现"传输即计算"的新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G边缘协作推理面临计算和通信开销大的核心挑战：多用户多模态中间特征上传消耗大量频谱资源，数字域融合推理引入显著的计算延迟和能耗。现有异构性处理方法（跨模态对齐、自适应推理、波束成形）各自仅解决单一异构源，且依赖灵活的数字域处理，难以适配SIM物理计算范式。

Method: 1）基于GNN的三异构性鲁棒适配器：构建包含kNN约束RBF核的图相似度矩阵，将CSI嵌入作为节点初始特征，结合质量感知对比学习（基于特征提取深度）对齐多模态多层级特征；2）混合波束成形网络：模型驱动分支采用MMSE启发的正则化信道共轭预均衡器执行相位预对齐和幅度预均衡，数据驱动分支采用Transformer编码器学习端到端映射，通过可学习softmax权重融合；3）SIM物理推理引擎：部署在边缘作为线性分类器，接收OTA聚合的空频信号矩阵，在单次波传播中完成空频联合特征融合与分类。

Result: 在COCO2017和SpokenCOCO数据集上，SIM-CI达到mAP 0.723，约为数字域基线BLIP-2（0.733）的98.6%，同时计算能耗降低25%，传输时隙减少75%，计算延迟降低76.1%。消融实验表明信道感知GNN和混合波束成形均对性能有显著贡献；在模型深度异构和模态异构（含语音三模态）场景下，SIM-CI均优于GCN/GAT/GraphSAGE基线，尤其在浅层特征占比增大时优势更明显。

Conclusion: SIM-CI通过将推理任务嵌入物理波传播域，配合信道感知适配器和混合波束成形，有效应对数据、模型和系统三重异构性，以接近数字域基线的精度实现显著的计算能耗、频谱效率和延迟降低，为6G边缘智能提供了可扩展、低延迟的新路径。

Abstract: In navigating the challenges of computational and communication overhead within the 6G-era Collaborative Inference (CI), this paper explores the feasibility of employing Stacked Intelligent Metasurface (SIM) to perform CI, termed SIM-CI. The SIM functions as a physical computing unit, receiving multi-user Over-The-Air (OTA) aggregated features within the same spectrum. It thus executes the necessary spatial-frequency combining and inference in a single physical wave this http URL -CI also incorporates a tri-heterogeneity robustness adapter to address the network heterogeneity, such as multi-modal data and user inference models, as well as a quality-aware contrastive approach that align features from different modalities and extraction levels into a unified feature space. Considering the heterogeneous and dynamic channels, we further integrate Channel State Information (CSI) as an additional input into the adapter design, enabling users' early perception of potential channel states. Moreover, to maximally mitigate the impact of channel variations, we design a new hybrid beamforming network that combines the robustness of model-driven pre-equalization with the adaptability of data-driven learning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our SIM-CI compared to digital-domain inference, achieving 98.6\% accuracy to conversional digital-domain CI approaches under various heterogeneous conditions, while reducing computational energy by 25\% and requiring 75\% fewer transmission time slots.

</details>


### [103] [ShoreKeeper: Accelerating Iterative Data Analytics in the Cloud via Distributed Recovery-Cost-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13396)
*Jongseop Lee,Minsu Sun,Xinyue Ma,Atul Sandur,Myeongjae Jeon*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: Sheper 是一个面向云端迭代数据分析（如 PageRank、ML 训练等）的分布式缓存管理系统，将集群内存视为统一弹性池，通过全局 MILP 优化同时决定数据块的缓存、放置与复制，以最小化恢复成本。它针对两大挑战——执行器间的恢复成本不均衡与抢占式实例的资源抢占——分别在稳定 VM 和可抢占实例上实现了显著的端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代式大数据工作负载（如图算法、机器学习）会不断产生大量中间数据，对内存需求极高。现有缓存策略（如 LRC、MRD、Blaze）仅做节点本地决策，假设节点高可用，但在云环境中存在两个关键不足：1）执行器间的恢复成本分布不均（数据倾斜、过滤比例不同、shuffle 重分布等导致部分节点内存压力大而过早驱逐高成本块）；2）抢占式实例的动态资源变化会导致关键缓存丢失，而云原生方案（如 Spark Decommissioner）随机迁移块、忽视恢复成本。论文通过 18 小时 AWS Spot 实例追踪和实验表明，这些问题显著拖慢端到端完成时间（最后一次迭代单节点抢占可增加 30–50% 完成时间）。

Method: akeeper 采用"统一规划器 + 运行时管理器"的清晰分离架构：(1) 离线 profiling 通过小输入 dry-run 初始化 lineage 图、分区大小、计算时间、网络/磁盘带宽；运行时在每个 stage 边界更新状态。(2) 成本模型：将分布式数据流合并为单一图，定义分区 p 在目标执行器 e_t(p) 上的访问成本（内存命中、远端网络传输、本地盘读、远端盘读+网络）和恢复成本（按父节点求和而非取最大值，反映集群整体代价），使用二进制变量 x_{p,e}（缓存位置）和 d_p（落盘）编码决策。(3) 求解器：对所有执行器构建单一 MILP，最小化目标分区集合 J 的总恢复成本 ∑R_p(e_t(p))，约束包括每执行器内存上限 ∑s_p·x_{p,e} ≤ C_e 和每个分区至多一处缓存或落盘。引入两种剪枝技术保证可解性：缓存块边界剪枝（裁剪已缓存块以上的祖先，V=O(ikP) 缩减为仅未缓存 lineage 深度）和 shuffle 近似（消除 shuffle 的 P² 边，将累积 shuffle 成本赋给输出，使 L=O(V)）。求解时间在 16× 分区规模下仍 < 4 秒。(4) 运行时管理器：通过 diff 新旧计划仅传输变化分区；使用异步、批量、流水线传输，仅占用 shuffle 阶段剩余空闲带宽；支持懒内存释放；针对抢占警报按恢复成本降序迁移；对 shuffle 分区进行轻量级主动复制（ρ 可配置，处理罕见的未警报抢占）。

Result: 在 11 节点 r5n.2xlarge（10 worker，20 executor，25GB/个）AWS 集群上，对 PageRank（PR）、Connected Components（CC）、Logistic Regression（LR）、SVD++ 四个基准测试，对比 LRU、LRC、MRD、Flint、Blaze 及 Blaze+D/Blaze+DF。VM 实例：akeeper 相对成本无关方法最高 6.11× 加速，相对 Blaze 最高 2.05× 加速，PR 收益最大（最高跨执行器不均衡）；CC/SVD++ 中等收益；LR 收益最小（工作集小且适配每执行器内存）。抢占实例（AWS Spot 追踪，Low/High 两个窗口）：相对 Blaze+D 最高 2.87× 加速（PR Low 窗口），即便 30 秒短宽限期仍保持优势。组件分解：Low 窗口下统一缓存贡献 ~80% 加速；High 窗口下成本感知降级与主动复制均贡献显著。运行开销：profiling 1.4–2.4%，求解 < 2.7%，迁移 < 0.05%。可扩展性：10→40 executor、输入 0.5×→2× 时相对 Blaze 维持 ~2.1× 加速，执行时间仅增 10.7%。剪枝后目标函数与无剪枝相比偏差 < 2%。与基于 S3 的全 disaggregation 方案相比，akeeper 快 2.02× 且成本低 66.9%。

Conclusion: akeaker 证明了在云端迭代数据分析中跨执行器管理恢复成本的必要性，通过将集群内存视为统一弹性池、MILP 全局优化缓存+放置+复制决策，以及针对抢占环境的成本感知迁移与轻量复制，在稳定 VM 和可抢占实例上均显著优于现有缓存与 checkpointing 系统。其规划与执行分离的设计、对 Spark 的实现（~8k 行代码修改 + Python Gurobi 求解器）、以及低开销特性使其具备实用性；理论上可扩展至 Flink/Ray/Dask 等同样满足"分区不可变 + 依赖图 + 可重计算"三属性的引擎。限制包括：当前仅支持单一资源类型（混合 on-demand+preemptible 集群需少量 on-demand 节点兜底）、离线 profiling 对短作业有启动开销、依赖迭代边界界定求解范围难以扩展至非迭代工作负载。

Abstract: Large-scale data-intensive workloads powered by iterative graph or machine learning processing have an insatiable demand for memory due to the continuous generation of new intermediate data. Although existing caching strategies strive to keep performance-critical data in memory, they often fail in practice because they are limited to node-local memory management and assume high node availability. In this paper, we introduce ShoreKeeper, a framework that maximizes execution efficiency by treating cluster-wide memory as a unified, elastic pool. ShoreKeeper employs a global optimization model that maps distributed dataflows into a single graph abstraction to minimize the recovery cost of data evicted from cache across the cluster. To handle memory working sets and cluster capacities that fluctuate over time, ShoreKeeper employs a graph-pruning technique that permits the fast refinement of the caching plan. These optimizations allow ShoreKeeper to work seamlessly whether deployed on highly available VMs or cost-effective preemptible instances in the cloud. Our experiments show that ShoreKeeper consistently outperforms state-of-the-art systems.

</details>


### [104] [CompileMask: Bridging the Gap Between Expressiveness and Efficiency in Attention Masking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13474)
*Hongzheng Li,Jiacheng Wan,Zhaolong Xing,Zhida Jiang,Yuanhang Yang,Junhua Shu,Jiaxing Wang,Xupeng Miao,Yingxia Shao,Zhen Chen,Ke Zhang*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: CompileMask 是一种用于高效注意力执行的系统，通过离线编译器将表达性强的掩码规范与高效的运行时表示相结合，解决注意力掩码中表达性与效率之间的权衡问题，最高可实现 3.8 倍的速度提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代注意力工作负载需要多样化的掩码模式，其边界依赖于运行时元数据，而高效注意力内核仅支持少量固定模式。现有方法面临表达性与效率的权衡：基于谓词的方法表达性强但开销大，基于区间的方法执行高效但表达性受限。本研究旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: CompileMask 采用两阶段流水线：(1) 离线阶段，符号编译器分析用户提供的 MaskSpec（基于区域的 DSL，每对查询行范围和可见性谓词）并生成掩码特定的预处理内核；(2) 在线阶段，预处理内核读取批次元数据，生成紧凑的 Execution Descriptor（包含 Interval Table 和 Tile-State Bitmaps），注意力内核通过将元素索引与预计算的端点进行比较来高效检查可见性。对于无法编译为区间的规则，回退到在线谓词求值以保持表达性。

Result: 在 NVIDIA Blackwell GPU 上的实验表明，在 HSTU、共享前缀奖励模型和 CLEAR 等掩码模式下，CompileMask 在单算子和端到端训练吞吐量方面均优于 FlexAttention 和 FlashMask 等先进方法。在 Qwen3-8B 上使用 HSTU 掩码的真实 KuaiRand 数据上，CompileMask 实现了 3.83 倍和 1.33 倍的端到端训练吞吐量提升。CompileMask 支持 FlashMask 四向量格式无法表达的掩码（如 CLEAR 多模态掩码），并在因果注意力上保持接近原生 FlashAttention-4 的性能。

Conclusion: CompileMask 通过将表达性掩码规范与高效注意力执行分离并由离线编译器连接，解决了注意力掩码中的表达性-效率权衡。实验验证了该系统在单算子和端到端训练吞吐量上的改进，同时保持了掩码表达性，显著减少了用户编写代码量和开发时间。

Abstract: Modern attention workloads require diverse masking patterns whose boundaries depend on runtime metadata, yet efficient attention kernels natively support only a small set of patterns. Existing methods for supporting custom masks in these kernels face an expressiveness-efficiency trade-off. Predicate-based methods are expressive but incur substantial preprocessing and execution overhead, whereas interval-based methods execute efficiently but restrict expressiveness through a predefined interval count. We present CompileMask, which addresses this trade-off by connecting expressive mask specifications with efficient attention execution. We design a compiler that analyzes visibility rules during the offline stage and generates a mask-specific preprocess kernel. We further propose MaskSpec, a region-based DSL that lets users express these rules. During the online stage, the generated kernel reads batch metadata and produces a compact Execution Descriptor that lets the attention kernel efficiently check visibility by comparing element indices against precomputed endpoints. Experiments show that CompileMask achieves up to $3.8\times$ speedup over state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [105] [GPU-resident Execution for Timing-predictable Sensor Processing Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13809)
*Soham Sinha,Rahul Choudhury,Shekhar Dwivedi,Gregory Lee,Gigon Bae,Anisha Goel,Elena Agostini,Patrick O'Grady,Yosi Levi,Mahdi Azizian*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文提出"GPU常驻执行"(GPU-resident Execution),一种新的执行模式,通过将I/O与GPU执行置于长生命周期的设备常驻循环中,消除每帧主机的唤醒与CUDA调用,从而显著降低实时传感器处理闭环系统的端到端延迟抖动。在工业级1080p 60Hz相机到显示流水线中,光到显示抖动从4.83ms降至0.66ms(7.3倍),软件处理抖动从1.70ms降至0.01ms(170倍)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前基于GPU加速的实时传感器处理系统仍由CPU主机作为每帧迭代的主控方,主机需观察传感器输入、提交CUDA任务、等待完成并提交执行动作。这种主机介导的闭环路径即使采用GPU内存RDMA或CPU核隔离等缓解措施,仍受I/O中断、主机调度和CUDA API开销的影响,难以保证时间可预测性。

Method: 1. 将传感器处理应用建模为有向无环图(DAG)的GPU常驻算子;2. 使用CUDA Graph while条件节点(WHL)或设备图尾自启动(DVG)将整个DAG封装为单一GPU常驻CUDA Graph,由主机仅启动一次;3. 在设备端实现数据就绪处理器(data-ready handler)轮询NIC接收完成队列或传感器元数据,无需主机唤醒即可触发处理流水线;4. 控制器核将数据就绪标志转换为if条件谓词,决定是否执行算子DAG;5. 端标记核完成单次迭代并重置标志;6. 结合GPUDirect RDMA(GPU内存RDMA)与DOCA GPUNetIO(GPU驱动I/O),实现传感器数据直接写入GPU可见内存,执行结果直接提交到设备可见输出端点。

Result: 在RTX A6000、IGX Orin和IGX Thor等多平台上评估:1. 单阶段推理微基准测试:对MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B0、ResNet-50等模型,标准差和绝对抖动降低1.4-2.4倍;2. 主机侧争用测试:在后台I/O和CPU负载下,CPU驱动基线抖动扩展至1.05-9.7.99ms(出现罕见长尾),而GPU常驻执行保持在9-86μs;3. 多环并发扩展性测试:10个并发环时,GPU常驻执行不预留CPU核,标准差从29.3μs降至7.6μs,p99.9从1113.6μs降至50.2μs,最大延迟从1850.3μs降至404.5μs;4. 框架开销:各图组件转换开销在0.05-13.67μs之间;5. IMX274相机到显示工业级案例(1080p 60Hz):光到显示抖动从4.83ms降至0.66ms(7.3倍),软件处理抖动从1.70ms降至0.01ms(170倍),最坏情况延迟从18.83ms降至13.35ms。

Conclusion: GPU常驻执行通过设计层面消除主机在稳态闭环中的参与,将端到端响应路径仅由设备侧图执行和算子成本组成,从根本上避免了Linux内核、驱动和CUDA API调度的延迟尾部。实验表明该架构在工业级实时传感器处理应用中显著收紧延迟分布并大幅降低抖动,为Linux托管GPU平台上的实时ML驱动传感器系统提供了时序可预测的系统基础。未来工作将扩展至更广泛的GPU驱动I/O支持(SPI、GPIO、I2C等)和更完整的感知-思考-动作闭环,以及GPU原生动作模型在实时控制回路中的部署。

Abstract: Real-time embedded systems increasingly place GPU-accelerated processing of high-bandwidth sensor streams inside closed-loop systems, but the CPU (the host) remains the primary orchestrator of each iteration. The host observes sensor inputs, submits CUDA work, waits for completion, and commits actuation. This host-mediated path exposes the closed-loop end-to-end latency to I/O interrupts, host scheduler decisions, and CUDA API overheads even after common host-side mitigations such as GPU-memory RDMA or CPU core isolation. This paper presents GPU-resident Execution, a new execution model for real-time sensor processing pipelines that keeps I/O and GPU execution in a long-lived device-resident loop. Sensor inputs arrive in GPU memory, trigger GPU-side processing, and reach GPU-visible output endpoints without any host wakeups. We implement the model in the NVIDIA Holoscan C++ framework and provide reference components for building GPU-resident applications. We evaluate our system on NVIDIA GPUs and SoCs with inference, host-contention, multi-loop, and streaming camera workloads. On an industry-grade 1080p, 60 Hz real-time camera-to-display application, GPU-resident Execution reduces photon-to-display jitter from 4.83 ms to 0.66 ms (7.3x) relative to a CPU-driven GPU-memory RDMA baseline and reduces software-processing jitter from 1.70 ms to 0.01 ms (170x).

</details>


### [106] [Scheduling in Cloud,Fog, and Edge Computing: A Comparative Analysis and Decision Framework for Technique Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13830)
*Rana Ghazali,Douglas G.Down*

Main category: cs.DC

TL;DR: 本文是一篇针对云-雾-边计算环境中任务、作业及工作流调度的综述性研究，涵盖启发式、元启发式、基于学习和混合方法，系统比较其在不同范式下的权衡，并提出指导技术选择的决策框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 云、雾、边计算的异构性和动态性使调度问题日益复杂，现有综述在计算环境、调度粒度或技术族方面覆盖较为零散，难以为具体需求下的方法选择提供有效指导。

Method: 对2020至2026年间发表的研究，从调度粒度、计算环境、优化目标、约束条件、性能指标和评估工具等维度，对启发式、元启发式、学习型和混合方法进行系统性比较分析，并据此构建决策框架。

Result: 启发式方法计算开销低，适合相对稳定的调度场景；元启发式适用于复杂多目标优化；学习方法对动态不确定环境适应性更强，但引入数据、训练、推理和收敛方面的新需求；混合方法能力互补但复杂度和实现成本更高。

Conclusion: 不同调度方法在计算效率、优化能力、适应性和实现复杂度之间存在明确权衡；所提出的决策框架可依据工作负载特征、环境条件、优化目标、资源约束和计算需求辅助选择最合适的技术。

Abstract: The increasing heterogeneity and dynamism of cloud, fog, and edge computing make scheduling a challenging problem involving diverse resource capabilities, workload characteristics, latency and energy constraints, and competing optimization objectives. Although numerous scheduling methods have been proposed, existing reviews often provide fragmented coverage of computing environments, scheduling granularities, or technique families, offering limited guidance on selecting an appropriate approach for specific requirements. This review presents a comparative analysis of task, job, and workflow scheduling across the cloud, fog, and edge paradigms, covering heuristic, metaheuristic, learning-based, and hybrid techniques. Studies published between 2020 and 2026 are analyzed according to scheduling granularity, computing environment, optimization objectives, constraints, performance metrics, and evaluation tools. The analysis highlights trade-offs among computational efficiency, optimization capability, adaptability, and implementation complexity across technique families. Heuristic methods offer low computational overhead for relatively stable scheduling conditions, whereas metaheuristic methods are suited to complex and multi-objective optimization problems. Learning-based methods provide greater adaptability to dynamic and uncertain environments but introduce data, training, inference, and convergence requirements. Hybrid methods combine complementary capabilities but generally increase computational and implementation complexity. Based on these findings, a decision framework is developed to guide technique selection according to workload characteristics, environmental conditions, optimization objectives, resource constraints, and computational requirements.

</details>

### [107] [PRIME: Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling Enhancement for Structured Document Retrieval-Real](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13296)
*Cheuk Hei Chung,Li Liu*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: PRIME是一个索引侧优化框架，通过LLM驱动的语义重构(SR)和确定性元数据合成与分层检索(MS+HR)两条互补路径提升结构化文档检索质量，发现确定性元数据以极低成本匹配结构感知分块质量，而SR在全部署中使Answer-F1提升13.7%，但这些索引侧收益在强重排序器下会被中和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IR研究主要优化查询侧检索器和生成器，将语料侧表示简化为分块处理，使得索引侧质量成为一个被忽视的优化杠杆。当强重排序器存在时，许多检索增强的边际收益消失，这促使作者探究是否可以通过优化索引侧表示来突破瓶颈。

Method: PRIME包含两条互补路径：(1) 语义重构(SR)：基于LLM按H2节段对文档进行显式化和压缩，保留原始结构同时提升信息密度；(2) 元数据合成与分层检索(MS+HR)：通过TF-IDF评分函数提取top-5判别性术语和标题树，构建高密度元数据嵌入用于粗粒度文档过滤，再结合BM25经RRF融合，最后用cross-encoder对节段级重排序。支持Offline(仅MS+HR)和Full(叠加SR)两种部署模式。

Result: 在QASPER上，PRIME(offline)在NDCG@5上匹配结构感知分块(0.396 vs 0.396)，但嵌入计算减少45.8倍、索引向量数减少22.4倍；PRIME(Full)虽在Dense-only下NDCG@5最高(0.214)，但BM25因词汇偏移下降，全部署下Answer-F1提升13.7%。BRIGHT跨域测试呈三种定性模式：赤字桥接(如Pony +175.6%)、结构利用(+4.6%~+22.3%)、结构饱和甚至退化(-3.1%~-23.1%)。NFCorpus因无H2标题而呈边界条件退化(-19.5%)。SR使语义密度提升127.3%，但4.3%出现NLI矛盾，25.7%文档证据保留率低于50%。在Hybrid+CE管道下所有索引侧差异几乎被重排序器中和。

Conclusion: 索引侧优化在上下文层面有效，但标准检索指标无法完整捕捉语料侧预处理的真实价值。SR的收益主要通过提升上下文质量而非文档级检索实现，且其效益可根据语料结构属性在检索前预测。SR存在质量-保真度-成本权衡，适用于陈述性、证据密集型文档，在过程推理或形式逻辑丰富的领域需谨慎。未来工作需建立基于文档结构条件的索引侧优化理论，并提升SR保真度。

Abstract: High-precision retrieval over external knowledge bases is essential for LLM agents to operate effectively. However, existing Information Retrieval (IR) research primarily optimizes query-side retrievers (e.g., ColBERT, BGE) and generators (e.g., Self-RAG, GraphRAG), while reducing corpus-side representation to chunking. This leaves index-side quality an underexplored lever. We propose Pre-Retrieval Index Modeling & Enhancement (PRIME), an index-side optimization framework built on two complementary tracks: an LLM-driven Semantic Restructuring (SR) track that transforms long documents into structured, information-dense sections, and a deterministic Metadata Synthesis (MS) and Hierarchical Retrieval (HR) track that extracts semantic anchors and heading structure for coarse-to-fine section retrieval. Our evaluations show that deterministic metadata matches structure-aware chunking's retrieval quality while cutting embedding computation by 45.8 $\times$ and index vector count by 22.4 $\times$. On top of these gains, Semantic Restructuring (SR) further improves Answer-F1 by 13.7% in full deployment, with characterized quality-fidelity-cost trade-offs. Across QASPER, BRIGHT, and NFCorpus, we further characterize three qualitative regimes that determine whether index-side optimization helps or degrades retrieval, while showing that these index-side effects are neutralized under a strong reranker.

</details>


### [108] [Beyond the Final Embedding: Retrieving Memories from Token-Level Evidence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13277)
*Han Luo,Zhan Zhuang,Xu He,Jujia Zhao,Yu Li,Suqin Yuan,Dong Li,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Memory-augmented assistants retrieve evidence from stored conversations and documents to answer queries. Most embedding-based retrievers compare single-vector representations of queries and memories, even when relevance depends on a small part of the content. Such local evidence can be matched to queries using the contextual token representations already computed by the same embedding models. Our method uses sparse token matching to improve retrieval without additional training. Each query token retrieves a small set of matching tokens across candidate memories. The matching scores are aggregated for each memory and combined with whole-memory similarity to rank memories. An optional low-rank query adapter can be trained with supervision while keeping the encoder and stored memory representations fixed. Our method improves retrieval across eight benchmarks and multiple model families without additional training. Query adaptation further increases the gains to 13.3 and 14.3 percentage points in average Recall@10 and NDCG@10 on Qwen3-Embedding-4B. These retrieval gains translate into higher question-answering accuracy on long-term memory benchmarks.

### [109] [Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13810)
*Amit Kumar Jaiswal,Sagar Uprety,Prayag Tiwari*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.

### [110] [NEAR: Neighborhood-Aware Residuals for Memory Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13314)
*Han Luo,Zhan Zhuang,Xu He,Jujia Zhao,Yu Li,Suqin Yuan,Dong Li,Lei Feng*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Memory retrieval aims to identify evidence from stored records to answer a query. Stored records with different factual details may share topics, entities, or events. Such shared contents would make records without the required evidence more likely to receive high similarity scores and outrank the correct evidence. In this paper, we use the information shared by these records to construct local references for query-memory matching. We propose NEighborhood-Aware Residuals (NEAR), a training-free framework that uses these references to construct residual representations that complement the original embeddings. Specifically, each memory derives a reference direction from its neighbors, and each query obtains its reference from a precomputed table. Using these references, NEAR constructs projection residuals for both queries and memories. These residuals are combined with the original embeddings for a single approximate nearest-neighbor search over a fixed memory index. Experiments on eight long-context retrieval benchmarks show consistent improvements across nine embedding models. Downstream evaluations show that NEAR improves question-answering performance.

### [111] [SPARQL-LLM in the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13648)
*Panayiotis Smeros,Vincent Emonet,Ruijie Wang,Ana-Claudia Sima,Tarcisio Mendes de Farias*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: Querying distributed data represented as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) via SPARQL remains a difficult task, requiring fluency in query syntax, endpoint specifications, and schema details. Knowledge Graph Question Answering (KGQA) systems address this by automatically translating natural language into SPARQL, and recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have made this translation increasingly feasible. In this paper, we describe SPARQL-LLM, our open-source KGQA system, in the context of the TEXT2SPARQL 2026 challenge. In this challenge, SPARQL-LLM ranks first overall among eight competing approaches across all datasets, achieving up to 59% higher accuracy than the second-best approach and supporting multilingual question answering in English, German, and Spanish. SPARQL-LLM is publicly released at this https URL and deployed in production over decentralized bioinformatics KGs at this https URL .

### [112] [Conditional Indexing Lower Bounds and Normalization Boundaries for Elastic Subsequence Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12938)
*Zemin Chao,Zitong Li,Xiangyu Gao,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study static indexes for exact subsequence matching over all equal-length windows of a time series. Under deterministic SETH, for every fixed $\beta\ge1$ and $\delta\in(0,1)$, we exclude $O(N^\beta)$ preprocessing together with $O(N^{1-\delta})$ worst-case query time on domains containing the reduction's polylogarithmic query lengths. The bounded-error counterpart assumes randomized SETH. The results cover specified warping, bottleneck, edit, subsequence, local-alignment, and complexity-adjusted scores. Their reductions share a data-independent query interface but require different arguments for all-window soundness. We give complete representative proofs for the distinct mechanisms and state the changes needed by related scores. For soft-DTW, integer scaling yields an exact Boolean-predicate reduction in Word-RAM; a model with exact transcendental primitives requires a separate assumption. For independent window-wise Z-normalization, balanced coordinate gadgets and shifted-window moment bounds yield exact lower bounds for squared-cost DTW and discrete Fréchet distance. We give finite-word comparisons and a specified length-dependent rounding rule preserving these gaps. Raw and normalized discrete Fréchet constructions also exclude feasible-solution approximation within any fixed factor below two. Finally, we prove conditional signal-attenuation bounds for normalized anchor constructions and a fast index under the all-window common-mean promise.

### [113] [Subset Sum and Integer Programming Feasibility Test in Near-Optimal Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12953)
*Lin Chen,Yuchen Mao,Guochuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Given an integer $t$ and a set of integers in $[N]$, Subset Sum asks whether there exists a subset that sums to $t$. A long open problem is whether Subset Sum can be solved in $O(N)$ time. We show that Subset Sum can be solved in $O(N^{1 + \varepsilon})$ time where $\varepsilon > 0$ is an arbitrarily small constant. Our result also generalizes to multi-sets in multi-dimension. That is, for any fixed $d$ and $\varepsilon >0$, the $d$-dimensional subset sum can be solved in $O(n + N^{d + \varepsilon})$ time. As an application, for any fixed $d$ and $\varepsilon$, feasibility test of integer programming with $d$ constraints can be done in $O(N^{d+\varepsilon} \mathrm{poly}(\ell_{\mathrm{in}}))$ time, where $N$ is the maximum absolute value in the constraint matrix and $\ell_{\mathrm{in}}$ is the input size. Although the algorithm is quite involved, its high-level idea is clear. It is already known that when the input set is dense and $t$ lies in the interior of the zonotope, then Subset Sum is easy to solve [Galil-Margalit '91, Bringmann-Wellnitz '21, Chen-Hu-Mao-Zhang '26]. Our key observation is that a sparse input can exhibit a dense structure when lifted to higher dimension. We show that such a lifting can be done efficiently. After lifting, the interior of the zonotope is easy to tackle, and one only needs to deal with the thin area near the boundary of the zonotope. Then we show that the boundary area can be decomposed into subproblems and solved recursively, and that there cannot be too many recursion levels since each level of recursive reduces the volume of the area significantly.

### [114] [Dynamic Matching with Abandonment: Optimal Guarantees via Static Priority Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12991)
*Nick Arnosti,Rad Niazadeh,Pranav Nuti,Felipe Simon*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study stochastic dynamic matching with abandonment, a fundamental model in which agents of different types arrive over time, may abandon the market while waiting, and can be matched in pairs for rewards that depend on their types. No online policy can guarantee more than $0.5$ of the omniscient benchmark, which knows all arrival and departure times. Whether this guarantee is achievable has been a central open problem, even in special cases. We resolve this problem by showing that, on every instance, a simple static priority policy, which is computable in polynomial time, earns at least $0.5$ of the omniscient benchmark. This establishes that the optimal competitive ratio is exactly $0.5$, improving the previous best guarantee of 0.192 for the general model [Li et al. 2026; Collina et al. 2020] Our analysis rests on a key stochastic result, which is a new lower bound on the probability that some agent from a given set of types is available. Building on this bound, we develop two approaches: a primal approach that reads the priorities from an optimal solution of a novel linear program, and a dual approach that assigns a ``value'' to each type, and prioritizes matches with high ``surplus'' (reward minus value of involved agents). These values are the unique solution of a fixed-point equation derived from linear programming duality. We also show that the two approaches are closely connected.

We resolve this problem by showing that, on every instance, a simple static priority policy, which is computable in polynomial time, earns at least $0.5$ of the omniscient benchmark. This establishes that the optimal competitive ratio is exactly $0.5$, improving the previous best guarantee of 0.192 for the general model [Li et al. 2026; Collina et al. 2020] Our analysis rests on a key stochastic result, which is a new lower bound on the probability that some agent from a given set of types is available. Building on this bound, we develop two approaches: a primal approach that reads the priorities from an optimal solution of a novel linear program, and a dual approach that assigns a ``value'' to each type, and prioritizes matches with high ``surplus'' (reward minus value of involved agents). These values are the unique solution of a fixed-point equation derived from linear programming duality. We also show that the two approaches are closely connected.

</details>


### [115] [Minimizing fuzzy Kripke models over residuated lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13010)
*Linh Anh Nguyen*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Model minimization is a fundamental problem in formal methods, as smaller models can substantially reduce the complexity of model analysis and reasoning while preserving relevant semantic properties. This work studies the minimization of finite fuzzy Kripke models over residuated lattices while preserving global or local assertions in fuzzy modal logics, which are either fuzzy propositional dynamic logic or a restriction thereof, optionally enriched with nominals, converse modalities, and/or the universal program constructor. We prove that, whenever the multiplication operator of the underlying residuated lattice is right-continuous, the quotient model induced by the greatest fuzzy auto-bisimulation is a minimal reduction preserving global assertions. If the underlying fuzzy modal logic includes the universal program constructor, this quotient model is also a minimal reduction preserving local assertions and a minimal fuzzy Kripke model bisimilar to the original model. In the case where the universal program constructor is absent and the multiplication operator is additionally strictly monotone with respect to~1, we present the first algorithm for constructing a minimal reduction preserving local assertions; the resulting model is also a minimal bisimilar model.

### [116] [Polynomial directed treewidth forces a large bramble with congestion two](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13270)
*Victor A. Campos,Raul Lopes,Rodrigo Nogueira,Ignasi Sau*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: Brambles of constant congestion in directed graphs have interesting structural and algorithmic applications, and it is desirable to find the smallest function $f_c(k)$ such that if a digraph has directed treewidth at least $f_c(k)$, then it contains a bramble of size at least $k$ and congestion at most $c$. By the Directed Grid Theorem of Kawarabayashi and Kreutzer [STOC 2015], such a function $f_c(k)$ exists for every value $c \geq 2$ of the congestion. However, even using the recent improvements due to Hatzel et al. [FOCS 2024], the resulting function is a power tower of height $22$. Recently, Masařík et al. [SIAM J. Discrete Math. 2022] proved that, for congestion $8$, the function $f_8(k)$ can be made polynomial; more precisely, they showed that $f_8(k) = \mathcal{O}(k^{48} \cdot \log^{13} k)$. They asked whether it is possible to decrease the congestion, ideally to $2$, even at the cost of a higher polynomial function. In this work we answer their question affirmatively with the best possible value of the congestion, by proving that $f_2(k) = \mathcal{O}(k^{96}\cdot \log^{23} k)$. We also obtain smaller polynomials for higher congestion, namely $f_4(k) = \mathcal{O}(k^{72} \cdot \log^{21} k)$ and $f_6(k) = \mathcal{O}(k^{66} \cdot \log^{18} k)$. Our results are inspired by the proof for congestion $8$, which we improve by introducing walkages. Walkages allow us to avoid technicalities of the original proof by translating ideas due to Reed and Wood [Eur. J. Comb. 2012] that work for undirected graphs to the directed setting. Our proofs are constructive and naturally yield polynomial-time algorithms to find the brambles assuming a certificate for large directed treewidth is given. Moreover, we discuss algorithmic applications of our results for the Directed Disjoint Paths with Congestion problem, and to half-integral packings of subgraphs with large directed treewidth.

### [117] [Deterministic Girth Approximation in Weighted Undirected Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13452)
*Avi Kadria*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We give deterministic algorithms for approximating the girth~$g$ of an undirected graph with $n$ vertices, $m$ edges, and nonnegative real edge lengths. For every integer $k\geq2$, our algorithm returns a cycle of length at most $\frac{2k}{3}g$ in $O((m+n^{1+2/k})k\log n)$ worst-case time. For every constant~$k$, this matches the stretch and the expected running time of the randomized algorithms of Kadria, Roditty, Sidford, Vassilevska Williams, and Zwick [SODA'23, SICOMP'26] and Kadria, Roditty, and Vassilevska Williams [ESA'26]. In general, it loses only a factor of $O(\min\{k,\log n\})$ in the term that depends on~$m$. The best previous deterministic trade-off, of Kadria, Roditty, Sidford, Vassilevska Williams, and Zwick [SODA'22], has stretch~$k$ instead of $\frac{2k}{3}$ at the same exponent (for even~$k$) and requires integer edge lengths. In particular, for $k=3$ we obtain a deterministic $2$-approximation in $O((m+n^{5/3})\log n)$ time for real edge lengths, whereas the deterministic algorithm of Ducoffe [SIDMA'21] for real lengths has stretch $2+\varepsilon$. Our main technical idea is that a deterministic construction of the Thorup--Zwick hierarchy used by these algorithms may stop exploring as soon as it finds a cycle: the approximation analysis only needs clusters truncated at half the best cycle certificate found, so balls stopped in this way need not be hit. Together with a degree-weighted selection rule, this bounds the work of each level by its number of edges and stored ball entries. More generally, a ball need not be hit whenever the analysis only uses clusters up to a radius bounded by a certificate that the algorithm has already found.

### [118] [Breaking Two Barriers for Dynamic Planar Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13473)
*Adam Karczmarz,Michał Włodarczyk*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We consider the reachability problem in fully dynamic directed planar graphs: the graph undergoes edge updates (insertions and deletions) and we receive queries asking if one vertex is reachable from another. The current-best online algorithm for dynamic planar reachability spends worst-case time $\widetilde{O}(n^{2/3})$ per query/update [Subramanian, ESA '93]. This can be improved to $\widetilde{O}(n^{1/2})$ in the offline setting or when the embedding is fixed [Diks and Sankowski, ESA '07]. Our contribution is twofold: 1. We present the first algorithm that breaks the square-root barrier for dynamic planar reachability in the offline setting, obtaining time ${O}(n^{0.49})$ per query/update. This shows that the problem is easier than answering distance queries in a dynamic undirected planar graph, for which a conditional lower bound of $n^{1/2 - o(1)}$ is known [Abboud and Dahlgaard, FOCS '16]. Notably, this lower bound applies to both online and offline algorithms. 2. Second, in the general online setting we design a randomized data structure with amortized update and query time ${O}(n^{0.664})$. This is the first improvement upon the exponent $2/3$ in over three decades. The main engine behind our theorems is a new sparsification framework aimed at maintaining information about reachability. Specifically, we study digraphs through the lens of VC dimensionality of certain set systems. First, we design sparse reachability emulators for planar digraphs that preserve the VC dimension. Second, we utilize orderings with a low ``stabbing number'' [Chazelle and Welzl, Discrete Comput. Geom. '89] to compute subquadratic reachability emulators in subquadratic time whenever the VC dimension is bounded.

### [119] [Tight asymptotic competitive ratio for the Canadian Traveller Problem on unit-weighted grids](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13712)
*Pierre Bergé,Vsevolod Chernyshev,Malory Marin,Alexey Pyrko,Lou Salaün*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: We study the $k$-Canadian Traveller Problem (k-ctp), an online navigation problem introduced by Papadimitriou and Yannakakis in 1991. Given an undirected weighted graph $G=(V,E,\omega)$ and two vertices $s,t\in V$, a traveller aims at navigating from $s$ to $t$ while minimizing the total distance travelled. However, up to $k$ edges of the graph may be blocked, and the traveller discovers that an edge is blocked only upon reaching one of its endpoints. The performance of an online algorithm for k-ctp is measured with the competitive ratio, which is the quotient between the distance actually traversed and the distance traversed by an omniscient traveller who knows all blockages in advance. A general lower bound $2k+1$ for the competitive ratio of deterministic algorithms remains valid even when the input graph is series-parallel, whereas constant competitive ratios can be achieved on restricted graph classes, such as cycles or unit-weighted outerplanar graphs. In this paper, we establish the first intermediate competitive ratio between constant and linear regimes. We prove that, on unit-weighted solid grid graphs, there exists an online algorithm with competitive ratio $O(\sqrt{k})$. This ratio is asymptotically tight and cannot be defeated, even on unit-weighted square grids. Finally, we show that both the unit-weighted and solidity assumptions are essential: going further with arbitrary edge weights (even on square grids) or non-solid unit-weighted grid structures yields a linear lower bound of $\Omega(k)$.

### [120] [Constructive Arboricity in Almost-Linear Time for Dense Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13937)
*Iman Gholami,Mohammad T. Hajiaghayi,Mahdi JafariRaviz,Alireza Kaviani,Soheil Mohammadkhani,AmirMohammad Shahrezaei*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: The arboricity of a graph is the minimum number of forests needed to partition its edges. We present a randomized algorithm that computes the exact arboricity of a simple graph and constructs an optimal forest partition in $\min\{n^{2+o(1)},m^{4/3+o(1)}\}$ time both in expectation and with high probability, where $n$ and $m$ denote the numbers of vertices and edges. In particular, it runs in almost-linear time, $O(m^{1+o(1)})$, on dense graphs with $m=\Theta(n^2)$. We also give the first known almost-linear-time algorithm that constructs a partition into at most one more forest than optimal.
