### [279] [Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlases for Amortized Conditional Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12737)
*Davide Wiest,Ahanaf Hasan Ariq,Abdul Monaf Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出KPSA（核化参数敏感度图谱），通过经验神经正切核的块分解导出归一化参数组敏感度，利用查询空间中的核检索摊销重复的梯度归因计算，实现无需每次反向传播的输入条件化可解释性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度归因能提供输入特定的参数信息，但每次反向传播计算开销大；静态重要性评分又丢弃了输入依赖性。需要一种方法在固定构建开销后，无需逐查询反向传播即可估计输入条件化的参数敏感度。

Method: 从经验NTK的块分解导出归一化块对角线作为敏感度目标（位于概率单纯形中），将源样本投影到查询空间，使用Nadaraya-Watson非负核检索对未见输入估计敏感度。理论上将误差分解为表示误差、局部目标不稳定误差和有限源误差三部分，并给出top-k恢复的边际条件。

Result: 在视觉（ViT-B/16）、预测（Chronos-Bolt）和蛋白质建模（ESM2）三种模态上，0.02%-0.1%参数预算下KPSA选中的参数组达到反向传播oracle 39%-85%的扰动敏感度；视觉神经元定位摊销后吞吐量从551提升至2041 images/s，峰值显存从4.55GB降至0.44GB，恢复81%的归因差距。

Conclusion: 紧凑的核图谱可存储有用的输入依赖参数敏感度并摊销重复的梯度归因，是迈向可扩展条件化可解释性的一步；但该方法局限于固定表示丢弃的变化、固定带宽的平滑偏差、归一化无符号能量不编码符号或有向计算、top-k恢复需要边际条件等。

Abstract: Gradient-based attribution provides input-specific information about model parameters, but computing it via backpropagation for many samples is expensive, while static importance scores discard input dependence. We derive KPSA (Kernelized Parameter Sensitivity Atlas) from a block decomposition of the empirical neural tangent kernel. It measures normalized parameter-group sensitivity, embeds those sources in an explicit query space, and uses a lightweight kernel to estimate sensitivities for unseen inputs. We derive bounds that separate finite-source from irreducible representation error and give margin-based top-$k$ recovery. This paper studies two interpretability applications. Firstly, KPSA identifies parameter groups with high susceptibility to perturbations across vision, forecasting, and protein-modeling setups. Across a fivefold range of parameter budgets ($0.02$-$0.1\%$), its selected groups attain $39$-$85\%$ of the perturbation susceptibility of a first-order backpropagation oracle. In vision and forecasting, these parameter groups form sparse sensitivity circuits that extend across depth and vary systematically with the input. Secondly, we use KPSA on an activation-attribution problem for MLP features in transformers. It retains $81\%$ of the gap between a backpropagation oracle and a constant-sensitivity baseline on vision while increasing batched query-time throughput from 551 to 2,041 images/s and reducing peak GPU memory from 4.55 to 0.44GB. On the protein-modeling task, it recovers $68\%$ of this gap. An ablation of KPSA's kernel aggregation shows that nearest-neighbor retrieval in KPSA space can remain competitive. The empirics show that compact kernel atlases can store useful input-dependent parameter sensitivity while amortizing repeated gradient attribution, a step toward scalable conditional interpretability. Code can be found at this https URL .

</details>


### [280] [Neural expectation-maximization and meta-models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12741)
*Zhuolin Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将Transformer解释为一种结合置信传播（LBP）与期望最大化（EM）的混合概率推断过程，提出"元模型"设计范式，将自注意力、MoE、门控机制等架构统一在输入条件参数生成的框架下。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Transformer解释（ICL的梯度下降视角、注意力与图计算的关联）未能将自注意力、深度、潜变量精炼、图结构选择与层间参数变化纳入统一的概率框架。

Method: 1）将编码Transformer底层建模为部分可观测马尔可夫随机场（MRF），其中结构与参数均未知；2）证明自注意力在二阶泰勒展开与各向同性Hessian假设下等价于max-product LBP，注意力权重编码结构亲和性σ；3）将每层前向传播视为E步、参数θ^(l)→θ^(l+1)的转换视为隐式M步，建立逐层EM对应；4）提出"元模型"范式：输入先生成实例特定参数θ=F_Θ(z)，再进行前向传播z'=f_θ(z)，可推广至高阶（参数指数增长）。

Result: 实验一：通过4种预训练Transformer（RoBERTa、DistilBERT、BGE-M3、Qwen3）对文本最后层特征做单链接层次聚类，证实复合词/短语被立即合并、指示代词与指代实体相邻、类 token最后才融入层级结构——支持MRF层级结构推断的解释。实验二：在多模态GMM合成数据（1/2/4/8个混合成分）上，Meta-Linear（含SwiGLU、PSwish等门控）在复杂任务上显著优于线性基线（M=8时0.6842 vs 0.5171），但仍低于使用真实专家数的MoE上界。

Conclusion: Transformer可统一理解为LBP-EM混合概率推断；自注意力≈动态结构MRF上的LBP；深度≈EM迭代；自注意力/MoE/GLU/LSTM/Mamba等都是元模型实例。提出未来工作方向：定量检验注意力图与依赖图的一致性、追踪Q函数沿深度提升、探索高阶元模型的表达力-参数权衡。

Abstract: We interpret Transformer networks as learned approximations to a hybrid probabilistic-inference procedure that combines max-product Loopy Belief Propagation (LBP) with Expectation--Maximization (EM). In this view, a Transformer performs inference in partially observed Markov Random Fields (MRFs) whose structure and parameters are not given a priori but are inferred from data. We show that self-attention implements a differentiable approximation to max-product LBP on an input-conditioned, dynamically structured MRF, with attention weights encoding learned structural affinities. We further establish an EM correspondence at the level of depth: each layer updates latent representations in an E-step-like forward pass, while the transition $\theta^{(l)} \to \theta^{(l+1)}$ across layers acts as an implicit M-step. Building on this interpretation, we introduce \emph{meta-models}, a design paradigm in which inputs generate instance-specific parameters, unifying mechanisms such as self-attention, mixture-of-experts, and gated units within a single framework. Empirical results support the proposed perspective.

</details>


### [281] [Static Gradient Attribution Underperforms a Density-Matched Random Mask on Loss-Based Forgetting Within LoRA B-Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12744)
*Yu Sun,Junwei Zhou,Zuodong Xiang,Yike Zhang,Pengcheng Xu,Xinyu Guan,Ruoyun Ma,Hailu Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在标准零初始化LoRA (B=0) 下，初始化时对 lora_A 的梯度恒为零（∂L/∂A=0），导致基于梯度的参数选择掩码只能在 lora_B 内进行，而无限制随机掩码从 lora_A 和 lora_B 共同池中采样——这混淆了"选择规则"与"候选参数池"两个变量。在匹配参数池与更新预算后，均匀随机掩码在损失型反向迁移（loss-based BWT）上一致优于梯度归因掩码（在Qwen2.5-3B、Phi-2上7个和4个种子验证）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 参数高效持续学习中，梯度归因是选择可训练子集的常用规则，但需要额外的校准数据反向传播。作者质疑：与零成本的随机掩码相比，这种归因带来的工程开销是否物有所值？同时指出既往比较存在"参数池混淆"——梯度掩码实际只在 lora_B 内选，随机掩码却跨 A+B 两个矩阵采样，两者在选择规则和候选池上同时存在差异，结论不可靠。

Method: 1. 提出参数池混淆分析：基于 ∂L/∂A = αB^T ∂L/∂W，在 B=0 初始化下 ∂L/∂A≡0，证明梯度掩码被强制局限在 lora_B 内。2. 设计密度匹配对比协议（D1）：两臂均从 lora_B 中各选 10%（Qwen2.5-3B 上 1,651,508 个参数），仅排序规则不同。4. 模型为 Qwen2.5-3B（4-bit NF4，LoRA rank=16），跨 5 个顺序任务（Code→Medical→Legal→Math→Creative），7 个种子评估损失型 BWT，并在两个离散选项任务上评估精度 BWT。5. 在 Phi-2（2.78B）上做密度匹配的 4 种子复制。

Result: 主结果（D1）：在 Qwen2.5-3B上 7 个种子中，随机掩码（Random-B）在每个种子的损失型 BWT 上都低于梯度掩码（Grad-B），均值差 Δ = −0.155（paired t(6)≈−5.80, p=0.0011），保留对单个种子剔除均稳健（p≤0.005）。Phi-2 上 4/4 个种子同方向，均值 Δ = −0.115（paired t(3)=−13.32, p=0.0009）。效应集中在 Medical 任务（占聚合差异约 80%），Code 和 Math 同向但量级小，Legal 无可靠差异。该模式与稳定性-可塑性权衡一致：梯度臂在每个任务的"对角线"拟合更好但遗忘更严重。两臂在 V100 与 A800 两套环境下均值差一致（0.155 vs 0.152）。精度 BWT 在两个离散选项任务上均值差为 +0.94 个百分点，95% CI [−2.91, +4.80]，跨零，预设的 4pp 非劣效准则不满足。

Conclusion: 在标准零初始化 LoRA 的 lora_B 内、相同参数数量下，均匀随机掩码在损失型遗忘上一致优于基于校准梯度的归因掩码，方向和量级在两个架构、两种硬件环境下复现。因此，归因反向传播在损失型遗忘意义上不被支持——消除它可省去一次 64 样本校准前向-反向（约占单任务训练预算的 12.8%）及校准数据需求。结论仅适用于：静态掩码、固定任务顺序、rank-16 标准零初始化 LoRA；准确性结论在 n=7 时不具结论性，需要更高功效的评估。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient continual learning updates a restricted subset of adapter parameters to incorporate sequential tasks while limiting catastrophic forgetting. Gradient attribution is a common rule for selecting that subset, but it requires an additional backward pass over calibration data. We identify a parameter-pool confound in comparisons between initialization-time gradient masks and unrestricted random masks under standard zero-initialized LoRA ($B=0$): the gradient with respect to $A$ is identically zero ($\partial\mathcal{L}/\partial A=0$), so gradient masks select strictly from the $B$ matrix whereas unrestricted random masks draw from both $A$ and $B$. Such a comparison changes both the selection rule and the candidate parameter pool. Isolating the selection criterion by restricting both approaches to the same parameter pool, we find a negative result: a uniform random mask consistently achieves lower loss-based backward transfer than gradient attribution across seven seeds on Qwen2.5-3B. The effect is concentrated on the medical task, which contributes 80\% of the aggregate; code and math move in the same direction, and legal shows no reliable difference. This advantage is consistent with a stability--plasticity trade-off under the tested task sequence, in which random masking slightly reduces single-task fitting. On the two discrete-option tasks (Medical and Legal), the mean accuracy-BWT difference is not statistically distinguishable from zero.

</details>


### [282] [NV-Tesseract-AD: Curriculum-Enhanced Conditional Diffusion for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12754)
*Aditi Gautam,Manikandan Ravikiran,Saira Qureshi,Sena Fatma Ekiz,Charan Jagwani,Mahmoud Elhadidy,Sanjeev Roka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NV-Tesseract-AD 提出了一种课程学习增强的条件扩散框架用于多元时间序列异常检测，通过沿掩码严重程度和扩散噪声水平两个轴的三阶段双课程学习，实现稳定的零样本异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于扩散的时间序列异常检测方法采用统一的训练调度，从初始化就暴露模型于完整难度范围（包括最难的掩码和高噪声组合），导致梯度不稳定和收敛缓慢；同时，时间序列中的结构性缺失使得重建难度沿两个独立轴（掩码严重度和噪声水平）变化，二者的联合管理尚未被系统研究。此外，部署性能与重建质量之间的差距由阈值校准主导，但现有工作并未对此进行系统分析。

Method: NV-Tesseract-AD 包含五个紧密耦合的组件：(1) 条件重建公式，将观测划分为条件集和目标集；(2) 掩码条件扩散过程，仅对目标条目施加DDPM前向腐蚀；(3) 基于Transformer的扩散去噪器，采用8层Pre-LN残差块配合门控残差细化；(4) 三阶段双轴课程调度，掩码比率从0.1递增至0.5，时间步采样区间分阶段扩展，并定义了形式化的难度度量 𝒟(m,t) = m·(1-ᾱₜ)/(ᾱₜ+ε(1-ᾱₜ))；(5) 基于残差的异常评分，采用DPM-Solver++进行加速推理及8样本中位数集成。训练损失结合扩散噪声预测损失、速度一致性正则和加速度一致性正则。

Result: 在TSB-UAD-M训练集上，NV-Tesseract-AD相比非课程基线F1提升约3.7倍（从0.0376提升至0.1404），MSE降低约56%；双课程在第一阶段即产生掩码不变的重建行为（互补掩码策略间的损失差距从0.0263快速坍缩至接近零）。在EasyTSAD零样本迁移中，NAB数据集F1达到0.9841，NormA达到0.9477。阈值校准分析显示，oracle AdjBestF1上界（0.244）与默认无监督阈值之间的差距远大于其与最佳调优配置（0.218）的差距，证实校准而非重建是主要瓶颈。DPM-Solver++将数据集级推理开销降低3.5–5.7倍（窗口级约40倍），但改变残差分布，需与阈值联合验证。

Conclusion: 沿掩码严重程度和扩散噪声水平两个轴的课程调度是稳定扩散优化和提升残差判别性的有效原则；该框架在严格零样本协议下实现有竞争力的跨域迁移，主要的部署性能瓶颈已从重建质量转移到无监督阈值校准；快速采样器是规模化运行的必要条件，但其选择与阈值机制存在耦合，需作为集成系统联合设计与验证。

Abstract: We propose NV-Tesseract-AD, a curriculum learning-enhanced conditional diffusion framework for multivariate time-series anomaly detection. Our central hypothesis is that reconstruction difficulty can be explicitly structured along two complementary axes, masking severity and diffusion noise level, and that training from easier to harder tasks along both axes simultaneously stabilizes optimization and improves residual discriminability. We integrate a Transformer-based diffusion backbone with a three-stage dual curriculum over masking ratios and diffusion timesteps, retaining anomalous samples throughout training and relying on structured corruption to drive self-supervised representation learning. We evaluate NV-Tesseract-AD under two regimes: in-distribution training on the TSB-UAD-M corpus and strict zero-shot transfer to ten EasyTSAD benchmark families without per-dataset tuning. The dual-axis curriculum produces masking-invariant reconstruction, confirmed by a near-zero loss gap between complementary masking strategies within the first training stage, and yields an approximately 3.7-fold improvement in F1 and a 56 percent reduction in MSE relative to a non-curriculum baseline. Zero-shot performance reaches F1 = 0.984 on NAB and F1 = 0.948 on NormA. Weaker results on heterogeneous families are traced to unsupervised threshold calibration rather than reconstruction quality, identifying calibration as the dominant remaining detection bottleneck. Accelerated inference via DPM-Solver++ reduces sampling cost by a factor of 3.5 to 5.7 at the dataset level but couples to thresholding behavior, establishing that the sampler and threshold must be validated jointly. Together, these findings demonstrate that aligning diffusion denoising difficulty with curriculum learning principles provides a principled and practical approach for robust anomaly detection in complex multivariate time series.

</details>


### [283] [Provenance-grouped protocol for evaluating machine learning in perovskite photovoltaics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12766)
*Qiwei Han,Chi Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出钙钛矿太阳能电池机器学习模型常用的随机数据划分因数据库内大量重复样本（近三分之二的器件与其他器件共享完全相同配方）导致严重信息泄漏，使模型评估偏向记忆而非泛化。作者基于机构溯源提出了分组划分协议，测试13个模型后发现：在随机划分下树模型占优，但在真正未见机构上组合感知（composition-aware）神经网络表现更佳；器件架构和制备工艺与吸收层化学组分同等重要。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前钙钛矿太阳能电池性能预测的机器学习研究普遍采用随机划分（random split）评估模型，但 Perovskite Database Project（PDP）中存在大量内部重复（同一"配方"出现于多条记录），这导致信息泄漏，使模型得分反映的是对历史数据的记忆能力而非对真实物理规律的泛化能力。亟需建立标准化的、能区分"记忆"与"物理发现"的评估协议。

Method: 1. 追溯 Perovskite Database 中每条记录的机构来源（institutional provenance）；2. 建立分层的分组数据划分（grouped splits）层级体系，逐步隔离三类泄漏源——重复器件（duplicate devices）、重复出版物（duplicate publications）、重复机构（duplicate institutions）；3. 在越来越严格的划分层级上基准测试13种机器学习模型，覆盖传统树集成方法（如随机森林、XGBoost）和组合感知神经网络架构；4. 通过特征重要性分析（feature importance）量化器件架构、制备工艺与吸收层化学组分对效率的贡献。

Result: 1. 约三分之二（~2/3）的器件与至少另一条记录共享完全相同的制备配方（recipe），证明随机划分确实存在系统性信息泄漏；2. 在所有划分层级（包括最严格的机构级未见划分）上均刷新了 state-of-the-art；3. 出现关键的"regime shift"：在随机划分下树集成（tree ensembles）通过识别熟悉配方而排名领先，但在真正未见的机构和未来发现场景下，其排名崩塌，组合感知神经网络（composition-aware neural architectures）跃居最优；4. 特征重要性显示，器件架构与制备工艺（fabrication methodology）对最终效率的影响与吸收层化学组分（absorber chemistry）同等重要。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个标准化的分层分组划分协议（hierarchy of grouped splits），使钙钛矿太阳能电池 ML 社区能够可靠地区分"记忆"（memorisation）与"真实的物理发现"（true physical discovery）；同时揭示了组合感知神经网络在面对真正新机构/新材料体系时的优势，主张未来相关研究应采用该协议进行模型基准测试。

Abstract: Machine-learning models for perovskite solar cells are typically evaluated using random data splits, which we show systematically leak information through massive internal duplication. Because nearly two-thirds of curated devices share their exact recipe with another, random splits primarily reward the mere recall of historical data rather than testing true physical generalisation. To solve this, we mapped the institutional provenance of the Perovskite Database and established a rigorous hierarchy of grouped splits that progressively isolate duplicate devices, publications, and institutions. Benchmarking thirteen models establishes new state-of-the-art performance across all splits and reveals a critical regime shift: while tree ensembles dominate random splits by recognising familiar recipes, their ranking collapses on genuinely unseen institutions and future discoveries, where composition-aware neural architectures excel. Furthermore, feature importance demonstrates that the device architecture and fabrication methodology dictate final efficiency just as strongly as the absorber chemistry. This standardised protocol empowers the community to separate memorisation from true physical discovery.

</details>


### [284] [Coordinate-Free Automatic Differentiation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12776)
*Alex Guerra,Joshua Aduol,Yaqian Tang,Daniel Williams,Ryan P. Adams,Peter Orbanz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种与坐标无关的自动微分框架，将多向量导数实现为JAX变换，可以表达多种几何微分算子，并在流形学习、时空逆问题、转子群优化等任务中复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的自动微分框架基于坐标数组定义梯度和雅可比矩阵，难以自然处理旋转、体积形式、曲率等几何对象。不同的几何算子需要针对特定表示（Christoffel符号、网格上的余切权重、基函数刚度矩阵等）重新推导，缺乏可重用性。

Method: 基于几何代数（Clifford代数）定义多向量导数 ∂_I F = Σ b^J ∂F/∂X_J，证明其仅依赖于内积空间和子空间 W 而与基的选择无关。利用前向模式 JVP 和反向模式 VJP 两种 JAX 原语实现该算子（前向需要 |I| 次 JVP，反向需要 |O| 次 VJP），通过 musical isomorphisms 解决 VJP 中隐含的欧氏内积假设问题，从而得到与坐标无关、可组合的 AD 变换。在流形上通过切空间投影 P(F) = (F⌋I^{-1})⌋I 得到内禀导数 ∂_M 和协变导数 ∇_M = P(∂_M F)，无需 Christoffel 符号或坐标系。所有几何量（形状算子 S = ∂P、Riemann 曲率、Ricci 曲率、标量曲率等）均可作为 ∂_M 和 ∇_M 的组合获得。

Result: 实验表明该框架具有良好的可复用性：(1) 在二维流形上通过无散向量流形将 S² 上的二十面体十二面体变形为 Z₅ 手性风车，将双曲盘 H² 上的 {3,7} 铺贴变形为 D₇ 齿轮；(2) 通过曲率损失加 Gauss-Bonnet 项训练流将正方形卷成球面（χ̂ ≈ 1.97），无需 Gauss-Bonnet 项则塌缩为球冠；(3) 隐式曲面学习在共维一和共维二情况下恢复准确极小曲面（Chamfer 距离约 0.01）；(4) Cl(1,3) 中从稀疏 Faraday 双向量观测恢复粒子螺旋轨迹（位置误差 6×10⁻⁴）；(5) 同时在 CGA(3) 的 T(3)⊂SE(3)⊂Sim(3)⊂Conf(3) 四个转子子群上向量化优化点云对齐，保形群匹配教师至 6×10⁻¹²，并能穿越 g=-1 共轭点。

Conclusion: 几何微分算子可以作为可重用的 AD 变换来暴露，而不是为每个坐标系或应用单独重新推导。同一套多向量导数、外导数和切空间投影算子通过选择不同的索引集 ℐ、多向量场以及切伪标量 I_M，在流形学习、时空逆问题和转子群优化等截然不同的工作流中复用。几何作为代数数据输入，几何结构（度量、方向、切空间）通过代数数据进入计算，而非针对每个具体空间重新推导。

Abstract: Automatic differentiation (AD) is a cornerstone of modern machine learning. Since all AD frameworks implicitly fix a basis of Euclidean space to define gradients and Jacobians, they natively process mathematical objects that are arrays of a fixed set of coordinates. This makes it awkward to express objects such as rotations, volume forms, and curvatures that arise, for example, in applications of AI to science. Bespoke workarounds lack reusability. We show that (i) a single, basis-independent derivative operator can represent many geometric differential operations, and (ii) this operator can be expressed entirely in terms of existing AD primitives. This reusable transformation can be composed with JAX batching, compilation, and hardware acceleration. Geometry enters as algebraic data. We experimentally demonstrate its reuse across different manifold operators, its composition through a spacetime inverse-problem pipeline, and its use in optimization over different rotor subgroups.

</details>


### [285] [The Expressive Power of Random-Feature MPNNs Across Graph Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12809)
*Robert R. Nerem,Mitchell Black,Antonis Vasileiou,Christopher Morris,Yusu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了带随机节点特征的消息传递图神经网络（MPNN）在不同图规模上的表达能力，提出了一个群体级框架，将连续随机特征量化为有限随机颜色，并证明此类 MPNN 不是大小均匀通用的，揭示了颜色数与试验次数之间的权衡关系及其与 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法的不可比较性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的随机特征 MPNN 理论分析不够精细，无法捕捉其在跨图规模逼近或固定随机比特数下的局限性，尤其是在大小均匀逼近（size-uniform approximation）方面的不足，这限制了对其表达能力与随机比特数依赖关系的理解。

Method: 构建了一个基于群体预测器的形式化框架，要求 MPNN 在初始特征上具有与图规模无关的 Lipschitz 界（包括均值、最大值和阶归一化和聚合等标准架构）。核心方法是将连续随机特征通过量化映射（quantization map）替换为有限调色板上的离散随机颜色，利用紧致性论证将量化误差控制在任意小范围内且与图规模无关。然后通过随机颜色 Weisfeiler-Leman（random-color WL）方法将有限颜色可区分性的限制转化为连续随机特征大小均匀逼近的限制。具体技术包括：使用 Cai-Fürer-Immerman (CFI) 图族构造需要指数次试验才能区分的图对；通过奇偶校验小工具（parity gadget）证明颜色和试验次数的严格层次结构；利用颜色编码（color coding）算法实现大小独立的树子图同构检测；并通过 Lipschitz 伪度量建立从有限训练集到大小均匀泛化的条件。

Result: 1) 证明了均匀 Lipschitz MPNN 的连续随机特征可被量化为有限颜色，量化误差与图规模无关（定理 3 和推论 4）；2) 证明了此类 MPNN 不是大小均匀通用的，即使在有界直径或有界度图上也成立（具体指 CFI 图族对应的推论）；3) 建立了随机颜色 WL 统计可区分性的严格颜色和试验层次结构（定理 7 和推论 25），证明了额外颜色可指数级优于额外试验；4) 证明了随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 Weisfeiler-Leman 方法不可比较（定理 2）；5) 给出了树子图同构的颜色编码 MPNN 构造和局部 MST 边检测任务，两者资源需求均与图规模无关（定理 9 和命题 10）；6) 建立了从有限训练集到大小均匀泛化的充分条件（定理 11）；7) 实验验证了在桥边预测和树子结构检测中增加颜色数和试验次数能提升性能，且推理时量化保留了大部分性能。

Conclusion: 本文提出的框架将连续随机特征 MPNN 的表达能力研究归结为有限随机颜色 MPNN 的分析，揭示了其在大规模图上的固有局限性——无法实现大小均匀通用逼近。颜色和试验次数是两种本质不同的离散资源，增加颜色数可指数级提升表达能力，而试验次数的影响呈对数级。同时，随机颜色 MPNN 与高阶 WL 方法不可比较，表明前者代表了一种独立的表达能力层次。尽管存在限制，有限颜色仍可有效实现如树子图检测和局部 MST 边检测等大小均匀算法任务，且从有限训练集可获得均匀泛化保证。这些结果为实践中使用随机特征提供了理论基础，阐明了随机特征在大小泛化中的能力边界与资源权衡。

Abstract: Continuous random node features increase the expressivity of message-passing neural networks (MPNNs), but existing theoretical analyses are not fine-grained enough to capture their limitations, particularly in approximating functions across graph sizes or under a fixed number of random bits. We develop a population-level framework for size-uniform approximation. For MPNNs with a graph-size-independent Lipschitz bound in their initial features, including standard mean, max, and order-normalized sum architectures, we show that continuous random features can be quantized to finitely many colors with arbitrarily small uniform error in expected output. This reduction lets us transfer limitations on finite-color distinguishability to limitations on size-uniform approximation with continuous random features. We use this framework to prove that these MPNNs are not size-uniformly universal, analyze the expressivity gains from colors and independent trials, and establish incomparability between random-color MPNNs and higher-order Weisfeiler-Leman methods. We also give finite-color MPNN constructions for tree subgraph isomorphism via color coding and a local MST task.

</details>


### [286] [Inverse Synthesis of Shock Time Series from Shock Response Spectra Using Ensembles of Conditional Variational Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12820)
*Adam Watts,Charles Young,Ryan Bowering,Andrew Jeon,Destry Newton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于条件变分自编码器（CVAE）的集合模型，用于从冲击响应谱（SRS）反向合成加速度时域波形。该方法采用循环小波解码器预测多尺度小波系数，并通过逆离散小波变换重建信号。在四个基准数据集上的评估表明，该方法在平均和中位谱误差方面均优于传统衰减正弦求和（SDS）方法及先前的直接时域CVAE方法，且推理速度显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冲击响应谱（SRS）到加速度时域波形的映射是多对一的，传统方法（如衰减正弦求和SDS）需要针对每个目标谱进行耗时优化，且受限于预设的基函数族。研究者旨在通过学习式生成模型直接从目标SRS合成兼容波形，并克服单模型潜在空间采样多样性不足的问题。

Method: 方法核心是CVAE架构，包含：1）卷积编码器；2）循环小波解码器（BandBlock序列），从粗到细预测小波系数，经逆离散小波变换（IDWT）重建信号；3）使用Hadamard或拼接方式编码目标SRS条件；4）由104个独立训练的模型（不同母小波和分解层级）组成集成，以提供多样候选解；5）复合损失函数（波形形状、时序、PSD、SRS和KL散度）。

Result: 在四个保留基准数据集（A: 963个操作冲击、B: 890个操作冲击、C: 815个地震记录、D: 1000个合成冲击）上，db10/8层小波CVAE将平均RMSLE较直接CVAE降低23.0%–34.7%，较SDS降低31.6%–59.2%。单模型推理时间0.1–0.6 ms，较SDS的5–8 s快约4个数量级。与Brake (2011)公布目标的对比中，CVAE在四个目标中三个上具有更低的MAE/RMSE。

Conclusion: 循环小波解码器有效提升了逆SRS合成的谱精度和推理效率，集成策略缓解了单模型后验坍缩导致的多样性不足问题。频谱一致并不保证物理适用性，未来工作将量化候选波形的多样性及时域/频域特性，并探索单模型内多样化生成及冲击时序合成的基础模型。

Abstract: The shock response spectrum (SRS) characterizes the peak responses of single-degree-of-freedom systems to transient acceleration. Because the mapping from an acceleration time series (waveform) to its SRS is many-to-one, inverse synthesis seeks candidate waveforms consistent with a prescribed spectrum. We extend an earlier conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) framework with a recurrent decoder that predicts multiscale wavelet coefficients and reconstructs waveforms through an inverse discrete wavelet transform. Individual models exhibit limited variability under latent sampling, motivating an ensemble of independently trained models spanning different mother wavelets and decomposition levels. Each member produces a separate candidate waveform for the same target SRS. Evaluation on four held-out benchmark datasets shows lower mean and median spectral errors for the illustrated wavelet model than for the earlier direct time-domain CVAE and a sum-of-decayed-sinusoids (SDS) baseline. A conditioning study examines frequency-grid and encoding choices. Comparisons with published inverse-SRS methods demonstrate superior performance across four holdout benchmark datasets (two operational shock datasets, one earthquake dataset, and one synthetic shock dataset) and competitive performance on synthetic targets reported by Brake. Single-model inference requires approximately 0.1-0.6 ms per waveform during batched inference compared with 5-8 s for SDS, excluding offline training. This low inference cost enables rapid generation of distinct SRS-compatible candidate waveforms across the ensemble, although their physical suitability requires assessment beyond spectral agreement.

</details>


### [287] [TreeHCA: Hindsight-Guided Exploration and Credit Assignment for Multi-Turn LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12828)
*Debajoy Mukherjee,Jeremy Carleton,Sushil Vemuri,Srinivas Shakkottai,Dileep Kalathil*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TreeHCA，通过将"后视引导的探索"与"后视信用分配"统一在同一后视变化测度框架下，解决多轮LLM智能体训练中GRPO对所有token赋予相同优势、无法进行精细中间信用分配的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GRPO等基于结果的策略优化方法为轨迹中每个token分配相同的优势值，无法区分有用和无用的中间决策；现有的后视信用分配（HCA）方法依赖采样轨迹中包含足够多的信息性替代方案，但在关键历史节点此类替代方案往往稀缺，导致信用分配信号不足。

Method: 1. 后视引导探索：使用参考答案似然变化作为后视分数，识别低分决策的父历史并从中采样N个候选替代延续，按归一化后视分数选择一个继续执行；2. 后视信用分配：推导后视倾斜采样的逆权重恒等式（含精确有限池恒等式），并通过归一化树备份将终端结果反向传播至回合级优势；3. 探索与信用共享同一后视变化测度原则，使用GSPO-token目标优化。

Result: 在7个问答基准（HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle、NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA）和3个Qwen骨干（Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct、Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B）上，TreeHCA在聚合精确匹配（EM）指标上超越所有基线；组件消融实验表明，后视探索+TreeHCA信用规则的组合在HotpotQA上达到51.76 EM和65.88 F1，优于其他组合；Qwen3-8B上比最强基线AEPO在多跳QA上提升1.63个百分点，单跳QA提升0.81个百分点；训练时间增加约9-11%。

Conclusion: TreeHCA通过共同的后视变化测度将探索与中间信用分配联系起来：后视分数引导替代延续的选择，逆权重补偿该采样偏好以估计优势。在问答任务上的评估和组件消融实验证实了该配对设计的有效性，验证了探索与信用共同设计对多轮LLM智能体训练的重要性。

Abstract: Outcome-supervised group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) assigns the same advantage to every token in an LLM agent trajectory, leaving useful and unhelpful decisions undifferentiated. Hindsight credit assignment (HCA) can refine this feedback, but its estimates rely on trajectories containing informative alternatives at consequential histories. We introduce TreeHCA, which couples hindsight-guided exploration with hindsight credit assignment. TreeHCA uses changes in reference-answer likelihood to revisit intermediate histories and sample alternative continuations, forming a tree of reasoning and tool interactions. Because this exploration changes the distribution of sampled continuations, we derive the corresponding inverse-hindsight importance correction, including an exact finite-pool identity. We use this structure in a normalized tree backup that propagates terminal outcomes into turn-level advantages. This shared hindsight structure is TreeHCA's central design principle, linking informative exploration with hindsight-guided credit assignment. Across seven question-answering benchmarks and three Qwen backbones, TreeHCA outperforms all baselines in aggregate exact match, validating the effectiveness of paired exploration and credit assignment for multi-turn LLM agent training. Our code is available at this http URL .

</details>


### [288] [Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization: Unified Learning from Offline Demonstrations and On- and Off-Policy Rollouts via a Shared Regression Target](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12830)
*Du Cheng,Junyu Lu,Jingfan Zhang,Yuzhuo Zhang,Haoxuan Jia,Shichao Weng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization（CBPO）的方法，通过共享固定参考目标的回归损失，将离线演示、在线策略和离线策略回放统一为单一优化目标，无需依赖行为策略概率、重要性采样或评论家网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的推理后训练采用两阶段流水线（冷启动SFT后接RLVR），将离线演示和强化学习回放分配给不同目标，导致离线数据无法持续复用、负样本演示被排除、早期回放在奖励仍然有用时被替换，造成优化路径迂回。

Method: CBPO基于KL正则化最优策略的闭式解，构建设计出的回归目标仅为：log π_ref(y|x) + r(x,y)/β - log Ẑ_ref(x)。该目标与生成补全的行为策略μ无关，因此不同来源（正负离线演示、参考响应、当前及历史回放）可采用统一的奖励标记记录格式存入共享重放缓冲区，通过单一平方损失优化。根据可用数据源的限制可派生出CBPO-Offline、CBPO-OnPolicy、CBPO-OffPolicy和CBPO-Unified四种变体。

Result: 在Qwen3-1.7B和Qwen3-8B两个模型规模上，针对AIME25、MinervaMath、AMC23和MATH500四个数学推理基准测试，CBPO-Unified均达到最优的avg@32和pass@32指标。在Qwen3-1.7B上，CBPO-Unified较SFT→DAPO在基准平均的avg@32和pass@32上分别提升2.33和4.44个百分点；保留历史回放较无历史配置再分别提升1.87和3.72个百分点。相比SFT→DAPO在投影参数空间中368.75°的累计转向和1.2207的路径比，CBPO-Unified仅需58.20°和1.0205的路径比，以更直接的路径抵达更高奖励区域。

Conclusion: CBPO为推理后训练提供了一种无需行为策略概率、重要性权重、评论家网络或目标切换的统一替代方案。固定参考回归目标、冻结的提示级归一化估计器与统一重放缓冲区相结合，使所有数据源被持续复用。各受限变体在对应数据机制下均优于同匹配基线，而统一变体在两种模型规模上均取得最优性能。

Abstract: Reasoning post-training draws on offline demonstrations and policy-generated rollouts, yet conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) separates their objectives and limits continued reuse of collected responses. We propose \textbf{Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization} (CBPO), which makes these sources compatible with one regression loss through a fixed-reference target. Because the generating policy does not enter this target, positive and negative offline completions, reference responses, and current and historical rollouts can share a common reward-labeled record format and replay buffer. As new responses enter the buffer, optimization retains the same regression objective without coordinating separate SFT and RL objectives or requiring stored behavior-policy probabilities, importance weighting, or a learned critic. Restricting the available sources gives offline, on-policy, and off-policy variants, while CBPO-Unified combines them. Across two model scales and four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, CBPO delivers leading \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} performance across benchmarks and data regimes. On Qwen3-1.7B, CBPO-Unified improves benchmark-averaged \texttt{avg@32} and \texttt{pass@32} over SFT DAPO by 2.33 and 4.44 percentage points, respectively. In the replay ablation, retaining historical rollouts improves these metrics by 1.87 and 3.72 percentage points over the no-history configuration.

</details>


### [289] [Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12848)
*Denis Blessing,Onur Celik,Gerhard Neumann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出固定点流匹配（FFM），一种无需数据的训练方法，可用于在强化学习中训练和微调流策略。FFM通过将评论家的动作梯度作为回归目标，将演员更新构建为固定点迭代，并证明最优策略是该迭代的不动点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在最大熵和行为约束强化学习中，最优策略为Boltzmann分布。由于该分布通常复杂且多模态，传统方法限制使用高斯策略以保证优化和似然计算的易处理性。流策略虽能表达复杂分布，但其训练通常依赖数据集，在在线RL中无法获取。此外，现有在线RL中训练流/扩散模型的方法面临内存消耗大、重要性权重方差高、需将流转换为扩散模型等局限。

Method: 1. **目标流恒等式**：将Boltzmann目标的流速度场表示为关于评论家动作梯度的条件期望，无需样本即可获得回归目标。2. **目标流匹配**：基于上述恒等式构建回归目标，与传统流匹配共享最优速度场。3. **固定点流匹配**：用当前策略的样本（而非最优策略的样本）评估该目标，形成固定点迭代，证明最优策略是不动点。4. **扩展**：包括速度空间中的信赖域损失、行为约束微调中的参考分数损失、时序相关的先验探索。5. **两个RL实例化**：最大熵RL（在线）和离线到在线的行为倾斜微调。

Result: 1. **离线到在线RL**（OGBench，50个任务）：FFM在线阶段1.5M步后平均成功率达0.95，超过最强基线TRQAM（0.93），在HumanoidMaze-Large等困难任务上优势明显（0.99 vs. 0.76）。2. **在线最大熵RL**（MJX Playground及人形机器人，24个任务）：FFM在低维Playground任务上与基线相当，在高维人形机器人任务上比TRUDI更快收敛到更佳性能。3. **消融实验**：验证了插值器类型、积分步数、动作压缩映射、确定性评估、相关探索等设计选择的有效性。4. **无发散**：所有种子上均无训练发散。

Conclusion: FFM为数据无关地学习表达性流策略提供了原理严谨的方法，无需通过采样链反向传播、无需重要性权重、无需将流转换为扩散模型或伴随模拟。实验证明该方法在最大熵在线RL和行为约束离线到在线微调中均具有竞争力或更优表现，确立了其在RL领域训练流策略的重要地位。

Abstract: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.

</details>


### [290] [Robust Langevin Sampling under State-Dependent Heavy-Tailed Noise with Applications to LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12865)
*M. Berk Sahin,Ege C. Kaya,Arda Fazla,Behzad Sharif,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的Langevin采样方法，用于在状态依赖的厚尾噪声和广义平滑条件下进行非对数凹采样，并将其应用于大语言模型的贝叶斯微调。核心贡献包括：1) 提出BG-p oracle，将Blum-Gladyshev条件和厚尾噪声模型统一推广，允许无限方差；2) 设计了三种方法R-LMC、A-LMC和RA-LMC，分别处理噪声、平滑度以及两者的联合挑战；3) 在Fisher信息度量下建立了非渐近收敛保证，无需耗散性或函数不等式假设；4) 在LLM和VLM的贝叶斯LoRA微调实验中验证了oracle模型并展示了优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非对数凹采样的SG-LMC收敛保证通常假设全局Lipschitz梯度和均匀有界噪声方差，但这两个假设在实际应用（如LLM贝叶斯微调）中常被违反。需要同时放宽这两个限制以适应现实场景。

Method: 1) 提出BG-p oracle统一状态依赖噪声增长与有限p阶矩(p∈(1,2])；2) R-LMC通过几何中位数中心化和残差裁剪处理厚尾噪声；3) A-LMC通过自适应步长控制广义平滑下的离散化误差；4) RA-LMC集成鲁棒估计与噪声感知步长，同时处理两个挑战；5) 使用Fisher信息作为收敛度量，无需耗散性或函数不等式假设。

Result: 1) 在合成实验中验证了三种方法的FI收敛；2) 在Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct的LoRA微调中，经验证明梯度误差呈厚尾分布且随距离增长（支持BG-p oracle）；3) RA-LMC在OpenBookQA和SLAKE数据集上以预测准确率和不确定性量化指标匹配或超越9种基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作通过提出统一的oracle模型和三种鲁棒采样算法，扩展了非对数凹Langevin采样的理论框架，使其能够处理实际深度学习应用中常见的厚尾噪声和非光滑势函数。理论保证和实验结果均支持所提方法的实用性和有效性。

Abstract: Existing convergence guarantees for non-log-concave sampling with stochastic gradient Langevin Monte Carlo (SG-LMC) typically assume globally Lipschitz gradients and uniformly bounded noise variance. Both assumptions can fail even in elementary sampling problems, and relaxing them better reflects practical applications such as Bayesian fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs). We relax both assumptions through generalized smoothness and our proposed state-dependent heavy-tailed oracle with finite $p$-th moments, $1<p\leq 2$. The oracle permits infinite variance when $p<2$ and includes the Blum-Gladyshev (BG-0) condition. We study these relaxations separately and jointly, proposing three methods. Under globally Lipschitz gradients, robust LMC (R-LMC) handles the proposed oracle through geometric-median centering and residual clipping. With exact gradients, adaptive LMC (A-LMC) controls discretization error under generalized smoothness. Robust adaptive LMC (RA-LMC) addresses both relaxations through robust estimation and a noise-aware step size. For all three methods, we establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees in Fisher information (FI) without assuming dissipativity or a functional inequality. Synthetic experiments demonstrate FI convergence and the benefit of each mechanism. Bayesian fine-tuning experiments with LLMs and vision-language models support our oracle model and show that RA-LMC matches or outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in accuracy and uncertainty quantification.

</details>


### [291] [HART: Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time series Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12883)
*Qingwen Lin,Boyan Xu,Shifeng Xie,Zhifeng Hao,Keli Zhang,Ruichu Cai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出HART（Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model），一种交替堆叠Transformer和RWKV模块的时间序列基础模型。研究发现RWKV-7在非自回归多步预测（NAF）设置下存在长远的性能退化现象，机制分析将其命名为"占位符空转衰减"（Placeholder Idling Decay, PID）。HART以仅36M参数在GIFT-Eval和TIME-Benchmark上取得了与Toto-2.0-1B相当的长远预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RWKV-7作为强大的循环神经网络语言模型，在非自回归多步预测（NAF）场景下表现出长远的性能退化问题。NAF要求模型在预测区间内仅依靠历史信息进行预测，预测区域的占位符缺少新观测值，导致RWKV的循环状态通过占位符驱动的状态转移时出现历史信息衰减的现象。论文将此现象命名为"占位符空转衰减"（PID），并寻求通过混合架构绕过此问题。

Method: 1. **PID机制分析**：基于广义差分规则（GDR）分析RWKV-7的循环状态更新，推导出预测区域中历史状态传播的数学形式，证明当write的补偿不足时历史信息会衰减。通过层级范数测量验证：写矩阵K_t的预测/历史范数比在大多数层小于1（0.60-0.87），而转移矩阵M_t的比值始终在1.00-1.03之间，与PID假设一致。2. **HART架构**：交替堆叠L个Transformer块和L个RWKV块（共2L层）。Transformer块采用RMSNorm、门控自注意力和SwiGLU FFN；RWKV块采用RWKV-TimeMIX（广义差分规则）和SwiGLU FFN。这种设计使得预测位置的RWKV输入已被前序Transformer块上下文化，可通过注意力直接获取历史信息。3. **训练**：使用连续patch掩码（CPM）预训练任务和Pinball损失函数，36M参数，使用Muon优化器训练220k步，预训练数据约8670万序列。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval（97个评估条目）和TIME-Benchmark（98个任务-频率组合）上：
- HART-36M的GIFT-Eval MASE：Short 0.689, Medium 0.727, Long 0.752, All 0.710
- HART-36M的TIME-Benchmark MASE：Short 0.618, Medium 0.716, Long 0.723, All 0.666
- HART在中长视野上显著优于纯RWKV（Medium和Long的95%置信区间不含零），并保持了相当的短视野性能
- HART在聚合指标上优于同等规模的纯Transformer（GIFT All 0.710 vs 0.721，TIME All 0.666 vs 0.670）
- 仅用36M参数（约Toto-2.0-1B的1/28），HART在GIFT-Eval上取得与Toto-2.0-1B相当的长视野MASE（0.752 vs 0.754）
- 合成信号实验显示架构排名与信号结构相关：RWKV在多成分SE4信号上表现最佳，HART在SE3（AM+相位跳跃）上表现最佳，表明两种建模方式互补。

Conclusion: 论文分析了RWKV-7在NAF设置下的PID现象，验证了循环模型在预测区域因占位符导致历史信息衰减的机制。基于此提出的HART混合架构有效结合了循环时序建模与注意力全局检索，在中长视野任务上显著优于纯RWKV，并在聚合指标上优于同等规模纯Transformer，验证了注意力与循环组合的优势。局限性在于：机制分析仅限于RWKV-7；范数诊断不直接测量保留的历史信息量；是否其他循环架构也存在相同机制需进一步验证；论文采用1:1的堆叠配置，其他比例与排列的效果尚未探索。

Abstract: Non-autoregressive multi-step forecasting (NAF) enables time series foundation models to predict an entire future horizon in a single forward pass. Despite its strong sequence modeling capabilities, RWKV-7 exhibits long-horizon degradation in our NAF experiments. In this setup, future patches are represented as missing inputs, requiring the recurrent state to evolve across the prediction horizon without new observations. Our analysis of RWKV-7's generalized delta rule suggests a mechanism we term Placeholder Idling Decay (PID): repeated state transitions can attenuate historical information when placeholder-driven writes provide insufficient compensation. Layer-wise analysis reveals reduced state-injection norms in most layers, while transition-matrix norms remain similar between historical and prediction regions, consistent with PID. Motivated by this analysis, we propose HART, a Hybrid Attention-RWKV Time-series Foundation Model that alternates attention and RWKV blocks, combining direct access to historical tokens with recurrent temporal modeling. Controlled experiments on GIFT-Eval and TIME-Benchmark show that HART improves over pure RWKV at medium and long horizons while maintaining comparable short-horizon performance, and achieves better aggregate performance than a comparably sized pure Transformer. With 36M parameters, HART achieves long-horizon MASE comparable to Toto-2.0-1B on GIFT-Eval (0.752 vs. 0.754), using approximately 1/28 of its parameters.

</details>


### [292] [CoGameReg: Cooperative-Game-Based Collaborative Semi-Supervised Regression for Seismic Reservoir Property Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12884)
*Zhiyu Guo,Jiwei Jia,Lei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Accurate estimation of reservoir properties from seismic data remains challenging when well-log labels are sparse but three-dimensional seismic observations are abundant. We present CoGameReg, a cooperative-game-based semi-supervised regression framework that uses contribution-weighted predictions of heterogeneous regressors to construct shared pseudo-labels. This design makes each regressor's influence explicit in the learning targets generated for unlabeled seismic samples under sparse well control. The Tri-Game Shapley mechanism combines a rank-MSE performance game with a pairwise consistency game to estimate nonnegative regressor weights from labeled training data. These weights remain fixed during collaborative training and are reused for final prediction fusion. Candidate pseudo-labels are screened using a common local k-nearest-neighbor error-reduction criterion before retraining. We evaluate CoGameReg on 10 public regression datasets, a synthetic three-dimensional P-wave velocity prediction task, and a field water-saturation application. The benchmark advantage is most pronounced at the 2.5% labeled-data ratio and decreases as supervision increases. CoGameReg obtains the best blind-well metrics in the synthetic experiment. In the field application, predictions clipped to 0-100% yield a pooled coefficient of determination of 0.5942, a root mean square error of 5.7441 percentage points, and a Pearson correlation of 0.8265 across three blind wells. CoGameReg has the highest Pearson correlation among the four field methods. The results support the use of CoGameReg to integrate sparse well labels with dense seismic attributes, with performance varying across metrics and well locations.

### [293] [Personalized Federated Direct Preference Optimization via LoRA Adapters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12885)
*Zhanhong Jiang,Soumik Sarkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Federated Direct Preference Optimization (FedDPO) enables privacy-preserving alignment of language models across distributed agents without centralizing sensitive preference data. However, existing FedDPO analysis assumes all clients converge to a single shared policy, which is fundamentally at odds with the heterogeneous preference distributions present in practice. We propose Personalized FedDPO (pFedDPO), in which each client maintains a small private LoRA adapter atop a shared global base model. In pFedDPO, the base model is synchronized via FedAvg each round, while LoRA adapters remain local and capture client-specific preference patterns. We prove that this decomposition replaces the gradient diversity $\kappa^2$ in the FedDPO bound with a residual heterogeneity $\kappa^2_{\mathrm{eff}}$, which is no larger than $\kappa^2$ when adapters absorb client-specific directions, at the cost of an additive adapter-bias term that vanishes as adapters converge. Experiments on preference datasets show that pFedDPO consistently attains a lower gradient norm than vanilla FedDPO while remaining competitive in training loss and per-client reward accuracy.

### [294] [GIST: Generator-state-Informed Supervision for Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12904)
*Zhangyang Peng,Jingze Shi,Tongyi Zhang,Yuyu Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on prior-data fitted networks typically use sampled hard query labels, leaving avoidable sampling variability in pretraining. A key observation is that intermediate generator states can reveal label uncertainty beyond a sampled outcome. We propose Generator-state-Informed Supervision for TFMs (GIST), which uses these states to average query losses over conditional label distributions. GIST jointly designs task generation and query supervision, using entropy-calibrated encodings to obtain tractable, input-consistent targets on supported label-dependent branches. We show that this averaging preserves the population objective and yields no larger gradient covariance at fixed parameters within each generating distribution. Under matched pretraining schedules, GIST improves mean rank across three architectures on both TabArena and TALENT without changing architecture or inference. Across these benchmarks and architectures, GIST wins 62.1% of paired dataset-level comparisons against the corresponding hard-label controls.

### [295] [Controlled-Minimax: Stabilizing Adversarial Optimization via Control Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12915)
*Tianjiao Luo,Jianfei Chen,Jun Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Minimax optimization is fundamental to adversarial learning yet suffers from severe stability challenges, often manifesting as persistent limit cycles or divergence. This paper investigates these instabilities through the lens of continuous-time dynamical systems. By modeling training dynamics as a second-order Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), we rigorously identify the root cause of non-convergence: the problematic eigenstructure of the loss function's Hessian near equilibrium points. To address this, we introduce Controlled-Minimax, a novel stabilization framework that reformulates the optimization trajectory as a controllable physical system. Unlike heuristic regularization techniques, our approach derives a specific feedback controller that provides theoretical guarantees of local exponential stability, regardless of the underlying Hessian spectrum. Consequently, our method stabilizes general minimax problems where traditional gradient descent-ascent methods fail. Extensive experiments on pathological benchmarks including the Dirac-GAN, 2D Gaussian mixtures, and Swiss Roll datasets, as well as high-resolution image synthesis with StyleGAN2-ada, demonstrate that Controlled-Minimax effectively suppresses oscillatory behavior while ensuring fast and robust convergence.

### [296] [DataCupid: Stable Matching Repair for Training Data Acquisition with Delayed Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12960)
*He Sun,Junyuan Mao,Wenhao Jiang,Mingjun Xiao,Shinan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Matching repair after utility changes can reuse valid observations, but new evaluations must respect matching capacity and may return out of order. We study announced invalidations with bounded, possibly reward-dependent reporting delays and pending evaluations that do not occupy future matching capacity. Residualload repair (RLR) combines sound outcome certificates with batched matching schedules for unequal sample deficits. Its complete dyadic quota schedule admits a sharp issue-round bound with coefficient cb < 1.607 relative to the terminal residual endpoint load, together with separate delay and evidence-lifetime bounds. RLR-P monitors complete issue-order prefixes without changing the sampling plan before acceptance. With a deterministic pure oracle, a single-repair coupling from the same drained initial state guarantees no increase in certification time, issued observations, or time to a reusable checkpoint. We also derive an information-load lower bound. On fixed priority-star markets with unknown Bernoulli gaps, PrioritySearch attains the history-adjusted first-order constant for expected certification time as {\delta} {\sim} 0, under hypothesis-independent linear history scaling and sublogarithmic reporting delays. Paired simulations and measured-feedback replay quantify the trade-offs: in the replay, RLR-P has lower mean capped update-certification time than a monitored width-based baseline, at higher oracle CPU cost.

### [297] [Diffusion Precipitation Generation with Medium-range Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12976)
*Guowen Li,Yang Liu,Mengxuan Chen,Jiashun Cheng,Haoyuan Liang,Shilei Cao,Yujie Wang,Juepeng Zheng,Fang Wang,Yerong Feng,Meng Jin,Hong Cheng,Yutong Lu,Haohuan Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Accurate daily precipitation forecasts are important for weather-sensitive decisions. Although recent Weather Foundation Models (WFMs) have achieved significant progress, they are trained on reanalysis data, which exhibit regional and intensity-dependent biases. Since retraining WFMs on observation-based targets is costly, we study Dynamics-Precipitation Decoupling, a plug-and-play framework that uses a separately trained generator to map non-precipitation forecasts from a frozen weather model to observation-aligned daily precipitation. Its key challenges are to capture heterogeneous rainfall distributions and align daily accumulations with atmospheric signals that evolve across space and time. To address them, we train a diffusion generator conditional on atmospheric states and satellite-gauge estimates of precipitation. A multi-scale recurrent encoder summarizes atmospheric evolution, while cross-attention aligns atmospheric and precipitation features during denoising. Extensive evaluation of various backbones, including Pangu-Weather, GraphCast, and HRES, on global and regional forecasting shows improved daily precipitation accuracy and event detection, with better representation of localized accumulation patterns. Global ensemble evaluation shows lower Brier scores than ENS and training-from-scratch GenCast at all reported lead times, with lower CRPS in most comparisons. Remarkably, a heavy-rainfall case study using 2,288 stations in China further supports improved daily accumulation patterns and event detection against ground observations.

### [298] [Gaussian-Width Bounds for Offline-to-Online Linear Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12990)
*Kushagra Chandak,Volodymyr Tkachuk,Xiaoqi Tan,Csaba Szepesvári*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: We study how offline data can help online learning in stochastic linear bandits. We focus on partially covered offline data, where only $k$ of the $d$ feature directions are poorly covered. Existing analyses of algorithms based on phased elimination and optimism give regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(\sqrt{dkT})$ in this regime. We show that this dependence arises from loose control of the reward prediction error, and obtain tighter bounds using concentration of Lipschitz functions of Gaussian vectors. Based on this analysis, we develop a phased elimination algorithm with regret $\widetilde O(k\sqrt T)$. For the unit Euclidean ball, we prove a matching regret lower bound under partial coverage, as well as matching upper and lower bounds under uniform offline coverage. We also study pure exploration with offline data, providing algorithms and matching upper and lower bounds on simple regret for fixed-design algorithms and also for adaptive algorithms under partial and uniform coverage of offline data.

### [299] [Evidential Multimodal Transformers with Dempster-Shafer Fusion for Emotion Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13013)
*Muhammad Usama,Yeoreum Jung*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Softmax-based multimodal emotion recognition methods often assign high confidence even when sensor data are corrupted or contradictory, for example when facial expressions suggest positive valence while vocal prosody indicates negative arousal. We present an Evidential Multimodal Transformer with Dempster-Shafer Fusion (EMT-DS) that addresses this problem through formal uncertainty quantification. EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.

EMT-DS models predictions as Subjective Opinions (Dirichlet distributions), separating epistemic uncertainty (lack of evidence) from aleatoric uncertainty (sensor noise). Modality-specific transformer encoders produce belief mass distributions that are fused with Dempster's Rule of Combination, which normalizes the joint belief mass by a conflict coefficient 1/(1-c), so that contradictory evidence is explicitly quantified as conflict and the fused prediction becomes diffuse rather than being forced into an unjustified consensus. Under subject-independent and speaker-independent evaluation on four benchmarks, EMT-DS achieves 84.3% accuracy on IEMOCAP versus 81.7% for the best baseline (p < 0.01), 82.4% on DEAP under leave-one-subject-out evaluation versus 78.1%, and 96.8% on the highly imbalanced KEMDy20, and it improves accuracy on CMU-MOSEI by 2.4 points over the strongest evidential baseline. In controlled ablation, it reduces Expected Calibration Error from 0.153 (softmax transformer) to 0.042. It maintains 71.2% accuracy under severe Gaussian noise on audio features (sigma = 1.0), where attention baselines drop to 45.3%, and degrades gracefully when entire modalities are absent. The fusion step has O(MK^2) complexity, compared with O(M^2 d^2) for cross-modal attention. The learned conflict metric also flags likely errors: reviewing 20% of samples captures 80% of misclassifications, which supports selective prediction in clinical and safety-critical systems.

</details>


### [300] [Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization: Closing the State Distribution Gap in Long-Horizon LLM RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13020)
*Zhicheng Cai,Weinan Dai,Yuyan Zhou,Wei-Ying Ma,Ya-Qin Zhang,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a dominant paradigm for enhancing LLMs' reasoning capabilities. Yet long-horizon autoregressive rollouts introduce a fundamental limitation: local policy mismatch can compound into severe state distribution shift over trajectories. Existing LLM RL methods, such as GRPO and GSPO, control policy mismatch at the token or sequence level, but overlook this trajectory-induced shift, causing training instability and eventual collapse as the horizon grows. To close the state distribution gap, we propose Trajectory-Aware Policy Optimization (TAPO), a principled framework that theoretically derives the state-distribution correction from the off-policy policy gradient and incorporates it into the RL objective. TAPO further employs a geometric-mean estimator for variance reduction, together with a length-aware dynamic clipping that prevents overly deviated updates across the trajectory. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TAPO significantly surpasses existing LLM RL algorithms across eight competition-level benchmarks, achieving up to 48% and 12% improvement over GRPO on mathematical reasoning and algorithmic coding, with substantially enhanced training stability.

### [301] [Low-Rank Kolmogorov-Arnold Generator Flows for Interpretable Operator Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13028)
*Minjong Cheon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Neural operators that learn physical laws from data should generalize beyond their training distribution and expose the learned law in closed form. The Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator achieves both for position-dependent dynamics by learning a dense pseudo-differential symbol over all positions and frequencies, at a cost that grows with the square of the resolution and with closed forms that must be read out by hand. This dense symbol is unnecessary: a finite-order variable-coefficient differential operator has a symbol whose separation rank is bounded by the number of its coefficient functions, independently of the resolution, and the symbols that this network learns on its own benchmarks have rank two. We introduce the Kolmogorov-Arnold flow (KAFlow), which learns the generator of a physical operator as a low-rank symbol built from univariate Kolmogorov-Arnold functions, fixes the gauge of these functions so that every term has a unique place, integrates the dynamics with exact exponential integrators, and distills its closed form automatically. On the synthetic benchmarks of the Kolmogorov-Arnold neural operator, KAFlow lowers the out-of-distribution loss by 3.4 to 11 times and recovers every coefficient to within 10^-4 without symbolic templates, reaching the precision floor of the data. On long-horizon quantum dynamics, it lowers the state infidelity by up to 6 orders of magnitude, and by 30 times when trained only on position and momentum measurements. KAFlow also learns a variable-order fractional operator 15 times more accurately than existing operator networks and discovers nonlocal, fractional and non-polynomial dispersion relations on which sparse regression fails.

### [302] [Target-Constrained Pooling for Trajectory Extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13034)
*Ning Wang,Claire Cardie,Sainyam Galhotra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Trajectory extrapolation from a partial target trajectory is underdetermined, but completed related trajectories provide information about the unresolved continuation. We propose target-constrained pooling (TCP), which separates the finite-horizon endpoint from continuation shape and estimates that endpoint from two complementary source signals. Uniform pooling captures final response levels, while matched-increment pooling captures the remaining change after aligning source and target states. TCP selects representative sources, projects both endpoint estimates onto a target-consistent region, converts them into corrections of the free forecast, and controls their influence through strength calibration and degradation-aware weighting. Across 25,245 targets from five domains and both forecasting directions, TCP reduces mean RMSE by 35.8% to 42.1% for all ten target-only forecasters and improves all 100 forecaster, dataset, and direction comparisons. The two endpoint signals consistently outperform either alone, while representative selection remains within 0.64% to 1.02% of the full donor pool using 12.7x fewer donor inputs and 138.8x fewer matching distance computations.

### [303] [Towards Easier-to-Tune Training Algorithms: New Results from AlgoPerf](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13036)
*Priya Kasimbeg,Ahmed Khaled,Aahlad Chandrabhatta,Yifan Wang,Andy Liu,Niccolò Ajroldi,David Tweedle,Xingyu,Yang,Isaac Patole,Frank Schneider,George E. Dahl*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Evaluating deep learning optimizer is challenging because confounding factors such as hyperparameter tuning and optimizer-model co-design often obscure true algorithmic performance. We present results of the updated AlgoPerf V1 benchmark, in which we evaluate a new set of training algorithms on wall-clock time-to-target across nine workloads on fixed hardware. This report focuses on the results of the benchmark's self-tuning ruleset, which requires submissions to use a single configuration across all workloads. Out of the 13 submissions in PyTorch and JAX, Schedule-Free AdamW ranked first. In addition to the wall-clock scores, we also analyze the trade-offs between step efficiency and wall-clock execution, revealing that matrix-preconditioned and two-loop methods achieve good sample efficiency but require more aggressive computational optimizations to be competitive in runtime. Finally, our hyperparameter saliency and retention analyses show that the learning rate and momentum are highly sensitive across domains and algorithms, highlighting the need for methods that are more robust against hyperparameter tuning and can generalize well to new tasks.

### [304] [CB-Orchestrator: Adaptive Workflow Optimization for LLM Agents via Contextual Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13064)
*Jiahang Sun,Zhiwei Shang,Zhipiao Liu,Hongwei Yang,Guoqing Xie,Shuang Qiu,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large Language Model (LLM) agents have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in tackling complex tasks through agentic workflows. However, manually designing these workflows is labor-intensive and lacks flexibility to adapt to diverse queries. While automated workflow optimization is a promising direction, existing methods often incur expensive API costs during training-phase feedback collection. Furthermore, they fail to adaptively reuse high-quality workflows, which creates a bottleneck for both performance and cost-effectiveness. To address these limitations, we propose CB-Orchestrator, an adaptive framework that decouples workflow generation from selection. In the first stage, we construct a diverse pool of candidate workflows via evolutionary search. In the second stage, we formulate workflow selection as a Contextual Bandit problem, which enables sample-efficient learning by balancing exploration and exploitation, thereby significantly reducing the feedback required for training. During inference, the model adaptively selects the optimal workflow tailored to each query. Evaluations across five diverse benchmarks demonstrate that CB-Orchestrator consistently outperforms all baselines. Notably, on the MATH dataset, CB-Orchestrator achieves better performance than strong recent baselines while reducing training-phase API token overhead by no less than 40.55% and total end-to-end training (including workflow pool generation) token overhead by no less than 29.73%.

### [305] [Double-Take: Improving Capacity, Binding, and Selectivity In Long-Context Within Bidirectional Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13073)
*Vakul Raghavan,Utkarsh Grover,Mingyang Mao,Chengwen Wang,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Processing a long sequence does not guarantee that distant information remains usable. As context grows, a fixed-size memory must retain many associations, connect information across positions, and preserve relevant structure without being overwhelmed by everything it observes. These are distinct requirements: a memory may store more information without representing the relationships needed for retrieval, and it may transport those relationships without preserving the ones that matter. Thus, the challenge is not simply extending context length, but constructing a memory that remains usable as context grows. We study this problem in large-chunk test-time training (TTT) and identify two basic failures: single-step writes accumulate interference, limiting capacity, while self-associative writes cannot form cross-position bindings. We introduce Double-Take (DT), which repairs these failures with multi-step unpinned updates and cross-position mixing, and adds bidirectional change-sensitive writes for selective retention. Capacity alone leaves end-to-end recall at the $0.10$ chance floor; adding binding raises it to $0.92$. Trained only on $32\,\mathrm{kb}$ genomic contexts, DT reaches $0.927$ AUROC at $131\,\mathrm{kb}$ and $0.856$ near $1\,\mathrm{Mb}$, while transferring zero-shot from human to mouse. Together, these results identify capacity, binding, and selectivity as three requirements for usable long-range memory.

### [306] [Human and LLM Facilitation in Collaborative Design Meetings: A Computational Behavioral Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13082)
*Mohammed Azeez Khan,Aaron Dsouza,Ashutosh Mishra,Ummul Faiz Z. Bibi,Neha K. Nair,Amar Kumar Behera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored as facilitators of group discussion and collaborative work, but the behavioral differences between LLM-generated and human facilitation remain insufficiently characterized. We compare human Project Manager facilitation turns from scenario-based collaborative design meetings with Llama 3.1 8B Instruct responses across 199 paired contexts from the AMI Meeting Corpus. The analysis covers five confirmatory dimensions: contextual semantic distance, a lexical elaboration proxy, empathyand-hedge lexical density, topic divergence, and phase-vocabulary alignment. An exploratory directiveness measure failed domain validation and is not interpreted. The sampled human Project Manager turns were higher on contextual semantic distance (r = 0.644) and on empathyand-hedge lexical density (r = 0.203). The second contrast is carried mainly by hedge terms, so we read it as lexical hedging rather than psychological empathy. Llama-generated facilitation was higher on topic divergence (r = 0.703), the lexical elaboration proxy (r = 0.288; lengthconfounded), and instruction-conditioned phase-vocabulary alignment (r = 0.382). A secondary no-phase check left the Llama-higher phase contrast in place. The system prompt still requested a facilitation move, so that check is not evidence of spontaneous phase awareness. These differences should not be interpreted as a ranking of facilitation quality. The resulting behavioral profile provides a reference point for later comparisons of LLM facilitators, human facilitators, prompts, models, and collaborative settings.

### [307] [Can Failed Trajectories Reveal Where Agents Go Wrong? Agentic Failure Attribution Without Step-Level Labels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13105)
*Do Nguyen-Thanh,Junlin Fang,Bing Li,Zhen Fang,Sean Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Failure attribution for LLM agents aims to identify decisive steps responsible for task failure, which is critical for debugging and improving agentic systems. Existing methods rely on costly LLM prompting, step-level error annotations, or verified successful trajectories that lack failure signals for assistance. In this paper, we study failure attribution from step-unlabeled failure trajectories, where each trajectory is known to have failed but its decisive step is unknown. We propose SOAP (Spectral scOring with Attention-guided Propagation), an effective framework requiring neither step-level training labels nor a separate success-only reference set. SOAP first constructs a spectral reference space from LLM representations and assigns each step a base error score according to its projection behavior. Importantly, later steps may exhibit stronger failure signals because they inherit an earlier mistake, causing independent scorers to favor downstream consequences over the decisive error. To address this downstream contamination, SOAP derives soft step dependencies from attention patterns and propagates downstream error evidence toward its likely upstream sources. Extensive experiments show that SOAP consistently improves attribution performance over competitive baselines.

### [308] [Scaling RNA Foundation Models through Iterative Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13106)
*Pengan Chen,Liang Hong,Xinyuan Liu,Han Huang,Ziqian Lin,Jiayang Chen,Yimin Fan,Jiyue Jiang,Yu Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Biological function in RNA is encoded across scales, from local sequence motifs to long-range structural dependencies. Conventional RNA foundation models couple parameter capacity and inference depth within a fixed architecture, prescribing a fixed computation graph for each inference. Here we present Eco-RNA, an 80M-parameter RNA foundation model that makes inference depth adjustable through learned iterative refinement. Its shared, input-conditioned Transformer core refines sequence representations through repeated application. The iteration count is selected after training and controls effective depth at fixed model parameters. We train across recurrent depths with masked reconstruction, state regularization, and a one-sided loss that anchors deeper reconstruction to a shallow reference. On the 70-assay RNAGym fitness benchmark, increasing refinement from one to four iterations raises aggregate absolute Spearman correlation from 0.242 to 0.286, with the gain retained through eight iterations. At four iterations, Eco-RNA surpasses the current SOTA Evo 2 40B on all three aggregate fitness metrics despite 500x fewer parameters. Its iteration configurations advance the compute-performance Pareto frontier among the evaluated models. It also outperforms the evaluated baselines in non-coding RNA family classification, RNA secondary-structure prediction, and chemical probing profile prediction. These results establish internal inference computation as an effective scaling dimension for RNA foundation models.

### [309] [WaSA: Wavelet Scattering Autoencoders for Unsupervised Offline Detection of Malicious Clients in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13186)
*Alessandro Licciardi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Federated Learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data, yet remains vulnerable to malicious clients injecting poisoned datasets. Existing defenses are typically reactive (operating during training) or supervised (requiring prior knowledge of attack types) - assumptions that rarely hold in open-ended IoT deployments. We propose WaSA, a fully unsupervised, offline framework for malicious client detection. Before training, each client transmits a single, privacy-preserving spectral summary of its data to the server. A denoising autoencoder, trained solely on clean auxiliary data, scores clients based on their deviation from the learned benign manifold, identifying corruptions regardless of the attack type. WaSA requires no attack labels, generalizes to unseen anomalies, and introduces a Boltzmann sampling strategy for client selection that smoothly interpolates between hard exclusion and standard aggregation. Experiments on MNIST, CIFAR-10, and CIFAR-100 under diverse attack scenarios (up to 90 % malicious clients) demonstrate consistent improvements over supervised baselines and robust aggregation methods, with negligible communication overhead. Code is available at this https URL .

### [310] [S$^3$R: Fast and Faithful RL Rollouts via Self-Sparse Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13202)
*Yuhang He,Hongyu Ge,Zihan Lin,Siyi Liu,Yongqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Fast rollout generation for long-context reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) requires reducing KV-cache traffic without changing the response groups used for policy optimization. In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

In our profiled RLVR workloads, attention accounts for 72--76\% of autoregressive decoding kernel time. Sparse attention reduces these reads, but sampling directly from a sparse policy changes the response groups used for learning. For group-relative optimization, we show that even exact response-wise reweighting does not generally recover the expected dense-policy update because the advantage of each response depends on the rewards of other group members. We propose Self-Sparse Speculative Rollouts (S$^3$R). It uses sparse attention to propose tokens, then generates responses through full-attention verification and exact speculative sampling. Drafting and verification share the same policy parameter, eliminating the need to train or update a separate drafter. The resulting response groups follow the dense-policy distribution. Under S$^3$R, we characterize speedup conditions and the costs of drafting and verification. We found that dense verification still requires the complete historical KV cache. A KV-aware scheduler therefore limits KV-cache repeated offloading and restoration while maintaining rollout parallelism. % OR thrashing In a matched ablation with an aggressive sparse drafting budget, S$^3$R maintains stable training while direct sparse sampling with training-side correction becomes unstable. On long-context mathematical reasoning, S$^3$R achieves $1.39\times~1.35\times$ the end-to-end training throughput of autoregressive rollouts on Qwen3 model, with comparable task performance.

### [311] [Rethinking Relative Policy Differences Transfer of On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13205)
*Rong Wu,Daocheng Fu,Yu Yang,Xuemeng Yang,Siqi Li,Shu Zou,Yao Zhu,Botian Shi,Bo Zhang,Cong Zhang,Pinlong Cai,Jianbiao Mei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a target policy on its own rollouts using token-level supervision from a stronger teacher, but typically relies on the teacher being substantially more capable than the target. Recent work relaxes this requirement by transferring the relative policy difference between an expert and a reference policy rather than the expert's absolute distribution. Yet it remains unclear which differences provide useful supervision and which targets can benefit from them. We develop a unified view in which the log-probability ratio between a proxy expert and a proxy reference defines an implicit reward for KL-regularized policy optimization. This formulation induces an on-policy update for the target, recovers conventional OPD as a special case, and enables any-to-any transfer across models that differ in scale, training stage or generation. Our systematic experiments yield three findings. First, a stronger expert is not necessarily a better source of supervision: differences induced by task-specific training, including reinforcement learning and supervised fine-tuning, transfer consistently, whereas those arising from model scale alone transfer weakly or not at all. Second, the expert and reference serve complementary roles: the expert provides the capability to be transferred, while the reference filters out shared behavior and isolates the relevant residual. Third, even a useful difference does not transfer to every target: success requires the induced update to move the target toward the expert and generalize beyond sampled rollouts. Raw policy distance does not predict transferability, whereas an appropriate reference can rescue otherwise unsuccessful transfer. These results characterize when relative policy differences provide effective supervision for OPD.

### [312] [How Much Computation Does Every Forecast Need? Structured Block Skipping in Two Time-Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13208)
*Max Bourgeat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Time-series foundation models use the same network depth for every input, although forecasting windows differ in structure and difficulty. We test whether whole Transformer blocks can be removed at inference time in two pretrained models: Chronos-Bolt and TimesFM 2.5. Our bypasses avoid the original block computation and preserve the dense model exactly when all blocks are enabled. Masks are selected only on calibration windows and evaluated on 1,088 held-out windows from ETTh1, Traffic, Weather, and Exchange. At moderate sparsity, Chronos-Bolt with 7/11 candidate blocks and TimesFM with 16/20 blocks show little change in mean relative forecasting quality across datasets while reducing median A100 batch-1 latency by 11.2% and 13.4%. More aggressive TimesFM skipping accelerates inference further but substantially harms Traffic and Weather. Across both models, different equal-budget masks win on different windows, and a retrospective oracle significantly improves over the best static mask on every dataset. However, dataset-specific masks transfer inconsistently, and Chronos representations do not support reliable unseen-domain routing. These results establish cross-architecture structured redundancy and input-dependent opportunity, but not a deployable dynamic inference method.

### [313] [Monarch-MoE: Structured Experts for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13215)
*Xi Zhang,Boyu Diao,Zesen Chen,Ruiqi Liu,Hangda Liu,Yongjun Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Learning new tasks in multimodal continual instruction tuning can cause catastrophic forgetting of previously acquired knowledge. Although multi-expert LoRA distributes learning across experts, updates to a dense low-rank expert can still affect many output features. We introduce Monarch-MoE, which replaces the dense factors in LoRA experts with block-diagonal factors connected by a fixed permutation. This structure provides blockwise gradient isolation: individual block-pair updates affect only one output block, while connections between all input and output blocks are maintained. To make these compact experts practical on memory-limited hardware, we combine batched computation, fused forward operators, and an optimized backward pass. Across three continual-learning methods evaluated on MLLM-DCL and UCIT with LLaVA-1.5-7B, Monarch-MoE improves first-task retention while reducing adapter parameters by approximately 75% and 50%, respectively. In the main comparison, first-task forgetting is as low as 0.52 percentage points on MLLM-DCL and 0.10 on UCIT, with method-dependent trade-offs in final performance. Our implementation supports fine-tuning and inference on a single 24 GB RTX 4090, with lower measured memory use and competitive runtime in the evaluated settings. Together, these algorithmic and systems improvements make structured experts a practical option for continual adaptation on memory-limited hardware.

### [314] [Tensor-based Fusion of Multi-modal Data for Predicting Cancer Risk Levels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13221)
*Ali Anaissi,Yuanzhe Jia,Qishun Peng,Weidong Huang,Ali Braytee,Junaid Akram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Cancer diagnosis and treatment increasingly rely on multi-modal diagnostic technologies that generate high-dimensional datasets. Although these datasets are rich in pathological information, they pose considerable challenges in interpretation, dimensionality reduction, and clinical applicability. Conventional machine learning approaches often fail to extract meaningful cross-modal features, thereby limiting predictive accuracy in patient risk stratification. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework that integrates feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering to improve cancer risk prediction. The framework employs tensor decomposition to fuse heterogeneous genomic and clinical data, enabling the extraction of latent, biologically meaningful features that outperform unimodal feature sets. Multiple feature extraction strategies are investigated, and the resulting features are subsequently clustered using a range of clustering algorithms. Comparative evaluations based on internal and external metrics are then used to identify the most effective configurations. The framework is validated on LinkedOmics data comprising 11,158 patients across 32 cancer types. For patient risk stratification, clinically relevant attributes such as tumor purity, pathological stage, and survival outcomes serve as ground-truth indicators. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of tSVD+GMM, which consistently outperforms other configurations across clinical benchmarks.

### [315] [Learning Schwarzschild Geodesic Motion with Lagrangian Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13234)
*Sukru Caglar,Sena Kalabalik,Abdullah Umut Hamzaogullari,Arkadas Ozakin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Lagrangian Neural Networks (LNNs) learn dynamics from trajectory data by parameterizing a scalar Lagrangian and deriving accelerations through the Euler--Lagrange equation, providing a variational inductive bias that improves physical consistency over purely data-driven models. LNNs have recently been extended to general relativistic settings, leaving Schwarzschild geodesics as an open challenge. Training on complex relativistic systems is hindered by the diversity of the dynamics, as well as numerical instabilities and the difficulty of adequately sampling physically relevant, diverse orbital regimes. We introduce two coordinated improvements: a decoupled position--velocity normalization scheme that independently rescales each coordinate and its time derivatives, reweighting acceleration targets to balance contributions across all channels; and an energy-constrained log-uniformly sampled dataset generation strategy informed by the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) structure. With these improvements, our model accurately reproduces perihelion precession and relativistic time dilation, conserves energy and angular momentum to within a few percent even after completing multiple orbits around the central mass and predicts orbital trajectories across eight orbital scenarios in close, medium, and far-field regimes. These results establish that LNNs, augmented with physically motivated normalization and sampling, can reliably learn geodesic dynamics in curved spacetime. Our work also represents the first successful training of LNNs on Schwarzschild geodesics and offers a promising direction for data-driven modeling of complex relativistic systems.
